### `app/api/announcements/[id]/route.ts`

````typescript
import mongoose from "mongoose";
import type { NextRequest } from "next/server";
import { HttpError, isValidObjectId, json, parseBody } from "@/lib/api";
import { withAuth, type AuthUser } from "@/lib/auth-guard";
import { canManageAnnouncement, canReadAnnouncement, getAnnouncementResidenceIds } from "@/lib/announcements/access";
import { publishDueAnnouncements } from "@/lib/announcements/publication";
import { Announcement } from "@/models/Announcement";
import { notifyAnnouncementPublished, recordAnnouncementActivity } from "@/lib/notifications/events";
import { announcementUpdateSchema } from "@/lib/validations/announcement";
import { AnnouncementStatus, Role } from "@/types/enums";

type RouteContext = { params: Promise<{ id: string }> };

async function loadAnnouncement(context: RouteContext) {
  const { id } = await context.params;
  if (!isValidObjectId(id)) throw new HttpError(400, "Identifiant invalide");
  const announcement = await Announcement.findById(id).lean();
  if (!announcement) throw new HttpError(404, "Annonce introuvable");
  return announcement;
}

export const GET = withAuth(async (_req: NextRequest, user: AuthUser, context?: RouteContext) => {
  if (!context) throw new HttpError(400, "Contexte de route manquant");
  const residenceIds = await getAnnouncementResidenceIds(user);
  await publishDueAnnouncements(residenceIds);
  const announcement = await loadAnnouncement(context);
  if (!canReadAnnouncement(user, announcement, residenceIds)) {
    throw new HttpError(404, "Annonce introuvable");
  }
  const populated = await Announcement.findById(announcement._id)
    .populate({ path: "author", select: "name" })
    .populate({ path: "residence", select: "name city" })
    .lean();
  return json({
    ...populated,
    category: populated?.category ?? "GENERAL",
    priority: populated?.priority ?? "NORMAL",
    audience: populated?.audience ?? "RESIDENTS",
    status: populated?.status ?? AnnouncementStatus.PUBLISHED,
    attachments: populated?.attachments ?? [],
  });
});

export const PATCH = withAuth(async (req: NextRequest, user: AuthUser, context?: RouteContext) => {
  if (user.role !== Role.ADMIN && user.role !== Role.SYNDIC) {
    throw new HttpError(403, "Modification réservée à ADMIN et SYNDIC");
  }
  if (!context) throw new HttpError(400, "Contexte de route manquant");
  const residenceIds = await getAnnouncementResidenceIds(user);
  await publishDueAnnouncements(residenceIds);
  const current = await loadAnnouncement(context);
  if (!canManageAnnouncement(user, current, residenceIds)) {
    throw new HttpError(404, "Annonce introuvable");
  }
  const { id } = await context.params;
  const body = await parseBody(req, announcementUpdateSchema);
  const targetResidence = body.residence ?? String(current.residence);
  if (residenceIds && !residenceIds.includes(targetResidence)) {
    throw new HttpError(403, "Vous ne gérez pas cette résidence");
  }
  const update: Record<string, unknown> = { ...body };
  if (body.residence) update.residence = new mongoose.Types.ObjectId(body.residence);
  const nextStatus = body.status ?? current.status ?? AnnouncementStatus.PUBLISHED;
  const nextScheduledAt = body.scheduledAt !== undefined ? body.scheduledAt : current.scheduledAt;
  const nextExpiresAt = body.expiresAt !== undefined ? body.expiresAt : current.expiresAt;
  if (nextStatus === AnnouncementStatus.SCHEDULED && (!nextScheduledAt || nextScheduledAt <= new Date())) {
    throw new HttpError(400, "La date planifiée doit être dans le futur");
  }
  const publicationTime = nextStatus === AnnouncementStatus.SCHEDULED
    ? nextScheduledAt
    : nextStatus === AnnouncementStatus.PUBLISHED && body.status === AnnouncementStatus.PUBLISHED
    ? new Date()
    : current.publishedAt;
  if (nextExpiresAt && publicationTime && nextExpiresAt <= publicationTime) {
    throw new HttpError(400, "L'expiration doit suivre la publication");
  }
  if (body.status === AnnouncementStatus.PUBLISHED) {
    update.publishedAt = new Date();
    update.scheduledAt = null;
  } else if (body.status === AnnouncementStatus.SCHEDULED) {
    update.publishedAt = nextScheduledAt;
  }
  const shouldNotify = body.status === AnnouncementStatus.PUBLISHED && current.status !== AnnouncementStatus.PUBLISHED;
  const shouldRecordArchive = body.status === AnnouncementStatus.ARCHIVED && current.status !== AnnouncementStatus.ARCHIVED;
  const updateFilter: Record<string, unknown> = { _id: id };
  if (shouldNotify || shouldRecordArchive) {
    if (current.status === undefined) updateFilter.status = { $exists: false };
    else updateFilter.status = current.status;
  }
  const updated = await Announcement.findOneAndUpdate(
    updateFilter,
    { $set: update },
    { new: true, runValidators: true }
  ).populate({ path: "author", select: "name" }).populate({ path: "residence", select: "name city" }).lean();
  if (!updated) {
    if (shouldNotify) throw new HttpError(409, "L'annonce a été modifiée simultanément. Rechargez-la puis réessayez.");
    throw new HttpError(404, "Annonce introuvable");
  }
  if (shouldNotify) {
    await notifyAnnouncementPublished(
      updated,
      `announcement:${updated._id}:published:${new Date(updated.publishedAt).toISOString()}`,
      user.id
    );
  }
  if (shouldRecordArchive) {
    await recordAnnouncementActivity(
      updated,
      "ARCHIVED",
      `announcement:${updated._id}:archived:${new Date(updated.updatedAt ?? new Date()).toISOString()}`,
      user.id
    );
  }
  return json(updated);
});

export const DELETE = withAuth(async (_req: NextRequest, user: AuthUser, context?: RouteContext) => {
  if (user.role !== Role.ADMIN && user.role !== Role.SYNDIC) {
    throw new HttpError(403, "Archivage réservé à ADMIN et SYNDIC");
  }
  if (!context) throw new HttpError(400, "Contexte de route manquant");
  const residenceIds = await getAnnouncementResidenceIds(user);
  await publishDueAnnouncements(residenceIds);
  const announcement = await loadAnnouncement(context);
  if (!canManageAnnouncement(user, announcement, residenceIds)) {
    throw new HttpError(404, "Annonce introuvable");
  }
  const archivedAt = new Date();
  const archiveResult = await Announcement.updateOne(
    { _id: announcement._id, status: { $ne: AnnouncementStatus.ARCHIVED } },
    { $set: { status: AnnouncementStatus.ARCHIVED, scheduledAt: null, updatedAt: archivedAt } }
  );
  if (archiveResult.modifiedCount > 0) {
    await recordAnnouncementActivity(
      announcement,
      "ARCHIVED",
      `announcement:${announcement._id}:archived:${archivedAt.toISOString()}`,
      user.id
    );
  }
  return json({ success: true, status: AnnouncementStatus.ARCHIVED });
});
````

### `app/api/announcements/attachments/[fileId]/route.ts`

````typescript
import { readFile } from "fs/promises";
import path from "path";
import type { NextRequest } from "next/server";
import { HttpError, isValidObjectId } from "@/lib/api";
import { withAuth, type AuthUser } from "@/lib/auth-guard";
import { canManageAnnouncement, canReadAnnouncement, getAnnouncementResidenceIds } from "@/lib/announcements/access";
import { publishDueAnnouncements } from "@/lib/announcements/publication";
import { Announcement } from "@/models/Announcement";
import { Role } from "@/types/enums";

type RouteContext = { params: Promise<{ fileId: string }> };
const FILE_ID_PATTERN = /^[a-f\d-]{36}\.(pdf|jpg|png)$/i;

export const GET = withAuth(async (req: NextRequest, user: AuthUser, context?: RouteContext) => {
  const { fileId = "" } = await (context?.params ?? Promise.resolve({ fileId: "" }));
  if (!FILE_ID_PATTERN.test(fileId)) throw new HttpError(404, "Fichier introuvable");
  const residenceIds = await getAnnouncementResidenceIds(user);
  await publishDueAnnouncements(residenceIds);
  const attachmentUrl = `/api/announcements/attachments/${fileId}`;
  const announcement = await Announcement.findOne({ "attachments.url": attachmentUrl }).lean();
  if (!announcement) throw new HttpError(404, "Fichier introuvable");
  const manager = user.role === Role.ADMIN || user.role === Role.SYNDIC;
  const authorized = manager
    ? canManageAnnouncement(user, announcement, residenceIds)
    : canReadAnnouncement(user, announcement, residenceIds);
  if (!authorized || !isValidObjectId(String(announcement._id))) {
    throw new HttpError(404, "Fichier introuvable");
  }

  const filePath = path.join(process.cwd(), "data", "private-announcements", fileId);
  let bytes: Buffer;
  try {
    bytes = await readFile(filePath);
  } catch (error) {
    if ((error as NodeJS.ErrnoException).code === "ENOENT") throw new HttpError(404, "Fichier introuvable");
    throw error;
  }
  const attachment = announcement.attachments.find((item) => item.url === attachmentUrl);
  const filename = encodeURIComponent(attachment?.name || "announcement-attachment");
  return new Response(new Uint8Array(bytes), {
    headers: {
      "Content-Type": attachment?.mimeType || "application/octet-stream",
      "Content-Length": String(bytes.byteLength),
      "Content-Disposition": `${req.nextUrl.searchParams.get("inline") === "1" && attachment?.mimeType.startsWith("image/") ? "inline" : "attachment"}; filename*=UTF-8''${filename}`,
      "Cache-Control": "private, no-store",
      "X-Content-Type-Options": "nosniff",
    },
  });
});
````

### `app/api/announcements/route.ts`

````typescript
import type { NextRequest } from "next/server";
import mongoose, { type PipelineStage } from "mongoose";
import { HttpError, json, parseBody } from "@/lib/api";
import { withAuth, type AuthUser } from "@/lib/auth-guard";
import { getAnnouncementResidenceIds } from "@/lib/announcements/access";
import { publishedAnnouncementFilter } from "@/lib/announcements/visibility";
import { publishDueAnnouncements } from "@/lib/announcements/publication";
import AnnouncementRead from "@/models/AnnouncementRead";
import { Announcement } from "@/models/Announcement";
import { Residence } from "@/models/Residence";
import { getEligibleResidentIdsByResidence, getReadCountsByAnnouncement } from "@/lib/announcements/readStats";
import { notifyAnnouncementPublished } from "@/lib/notifications/events";
import {
  announcementCreateSchema,
  announcementListQuerySchema,
} from "@/lib/validations/announcement";
import { Role, AnnouncementStatus } from "@/types/enums";

function validDate(value: string | undefined, end = false) {
  if (!value) return undefined;
  const parsed = new Date(`${value}T${end ? "23:59:59.999" : "00:00:00.000"}Z`);
  if (Number.isNaN(parsed.getTime()) || parsed.toISOString().slice(0, 10) !== value) {
    throw new HttpError(400, "Période de dates invalide");
  }
  return parsed;
}

function safeSearch(value: string) {
  return new RegExp(value.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, "\\$&"), "i");
}

function relationId(value: unknown) {
  if (value && typeof value === "object" && "_id" in value) {
    return String((value as { _id: unknown })._id);
  }
  return String(value);
}

export const GET = withAuth(async (req: NextRequest, user: AuthUser) => {
  const parsed = announcementListQuerySchema.safeParse(
    Object.fromEntries(req.nextUrl.searchParams.entries())
  );
  if (!parsed.success) throw new HttpError(400, "Filtres invalides", parsed.error.flatten());
  const query = parsed.data;
  const residenceIds = await getAnnouncementResidenceIds(user);
  await publishDueAnnouncements(residenceIds);
  const conditions: Record<string, unknown>[] = [];

  if (residenceIds) {
    conditions.push({
      residence: { $in: residenceIds.map((id) => new mongoose.Types.ObjectId(id)) },
    });
  }
  if (query.residence) {
    if (residenceIds && !residenceIds.includes(query.residence)) {
      throw new HttpError(403, "Vous n'avez pas accès à cette résidence");
    }
    conditions.push({ residence: new mongoose.Types.ObjectId(query.residence) });
  }

  if (user.role === Role.ADMIN || user.role === Role.SYNDIC) {
    const now = new Date();
    if (query.status === "EXPIRED") {
      conditions.push({
        $and: [
          { $or: [{ status: AnnouncementStatus.PUBLISHED }, { status: { $exists: false } }] },
          { $or: [{ scheduledAt: null }, { scheduledAt: { $exists: false } }, { scheduledAt: { $lte: now } }] },
          { expiresAt: { $lte: now } },
        ],
      });
    } else if (query.status) {
      conditions.push(query.status === AnnouncementStatus.PUBLISHED
        ? {
            $and: [
              { $or: [{ status: AnnouncementStatus.PUBLISHED }, { status: { $exists: false } }] },
              { $or: [{ scheduledAt: null }, { scheduledAt: { $exists: false } }, { scheduledAt: { $lte: now } }] },
              { $or: [{ expiresAt: null }, { expiresAt: { $exists: false } }, { expiresAt: { $gt: now } }] },
            ],
          }
        : { status: query.status });
    }
    if (query.audience) conditions.push({ audience: query.audience });
  } else {
    conditions.push(publishedAnnouncementFilter());
    conditions.push(user.role === Role.RESIDENT
      ? {
          $or: [
            { audience: { $in: ["RESIDENTS", "ALL"] } },
            { audience: { $exists: false } },
          ],
        }
      : { audience: { $in: ["TECHNICIANS", "ALL"] } });
  }

  if (query.category) conditions.push({ category: query.category });
  if (query.priority) conditions.push({ priority: query.priority });
  const from = validDate(query.from);
  const to = validDate(query.to, true);
  if (from && to && from > to) throw new HttpError(400, "La date de début doit précéder la date de fin");
  if (from || to) {
    const dateRange = {
      ...(from ? { $gte: from } : {}),
      ...(to ? { $lte: to } : {}),
    };
    conditions.push({
      $or: [
        { publishedAt: dateRange },
        { scheduledAt: dateRange },
      ],
    });
  }
  if (query.q) {
    const regex = safeSearch(query.q);
    conditions.push({ $or: [{ title: regex }, { content: regex }] });
  }

  if (user.role === Role.RESIDENT && query.read) {
    const readIds = await AnnouncementRead.distinct("announcement", { resident: user.id });
    conditions.push(query.read === "true"
      ? { _id: { $in: readIds } }
      : { _id: { $nin: readIds } });
  }

  const filter = conditions.length ? { $and: conditions } : {};
  const [announcements, total] = await Promise.all([
    (async () => {
      if (query.sort === "priority") {
        const ordered = await Announcement.aggregate<{ _id: mongoose.Types.ObjectId }>([
          { $match: filter as PipelineStage.Match["$match"] },
          {
            $addFields: {
              priorityRank: {
                $switch: {
                  branches: [
                    { case: { $eq: ["$priority", "URGENT"] }, then: 4 },
                    { case: { $eq: ["$priority", "HIGH"] }, then: 3 },
                    { case: { $eq: ["$priority", "NORMAL"] }, then: 2 },
                  ],
                  default: 1,
                },
              },
            },
          },
          { $sort: { isPinned: -1, priorityRank: -1, publishedAt: -1 } },
          { $skip: (query.page - 1) * query.limit },
          { $limit: query.limit },
          { $project: { _id: 1 } },
        ]);
        if (!ordered.length) return [];
        const results = await Announcement.find({ _id: { $in: ordered.map((item) => item._id) } })
          .populate({ path: "author", select: "name" })
          .populate({ path: "residence", select: "name city" })
          .lean();
        const byId = new Map(results.map((item) => [String(item._id), item]));
        return ordered.map((item) => byId.get(String(item._id))).filter((item) => item !== undefined);
      }
      const sort: Record<string, 1 | -1> = query.sort === "oldest"
        ? { isPinned: -1, publishedAt: 1 }
        : { isPinned: -1, publishedAt: -1 };
      return Announcement.find(filter)
        .sort(sort)
        .skip((query.page - 1) * query.limit)
        .limit(query.limit)
        .populate({ path: "author", select: "name" })
        .populate({ path: "residence", select: "name city" })
        .lean();
    })(),
    Announcement.countDocuments(filter),
  ]);
  const readIds = user.role === Role.RESIDENT
    ? new Set((await AnnouncementRead.distinct("announcement", {
        resident: user.id,
        announcement: { $in: announcements.map((item) => item._id) },
      })).map(String))
    : new Set<string>();
  const canViewReadStats = user.role === Role.ADMIN || user.role === Role.SYNDIC;
  const residenceKeys = canViewReadStats
    ? [...new Set(announcements.map((item) => relationId(item.residence)))]
    : [];
  const eligibleByResidence = canViewReadStats
    ? await getEligibleResidentIdsByResidence(residenceKeys)
    : new Map<string, Set<string>>();
  const readCounts = canViewReadStats
    ? await getReadCountsByAnnouncement(announcements.map((item) => ({
        id: String(item._id),
        residenceId: relationId(item.residence),
      })), eligibleByResidence)
    : new Map<string, number>();

  return json({
    data: announcements.map((item) => ({
      ...item,
      category: item.category ?? "GENERAL",
      priority: item.priority ?? "NORMAL",
      audience: item.audience ?? "RESIDENTS",
      status: item.status ?? AnnouncementStatus.PUBLISHED,
      attachments: item.attachments ?? [],
      isRead: readIds.has(String(item._id)),
      readStats: canViewReadStats
        ? (() => {
            const audience = item.audience ?? "RESIDENTS";
            const eligible = audience === "TECHNICIANS"
              ? 0
              : eligibleByResidence.get(relationId(item.residence))?.size ?? 0;
            const reads = Math.min(readCounts.get(String(item._id)) ?? 0, eligible);
            return {
              totalEligibleResidents: eligible,
              readCount: reads,
              unreadCount: Math.max(0, eligible - reads),
              readPercentage: eligible ? Math.round((reads / eligible) * 100) : 0,
            };
          })()
        : undefined,
    })),
    meta: { page: query.page, limit: query.limit, total },
  });
});

export const POST = withAuth(async (req: NextRequest, user: AuthUser) => {
  if (user.role !== Role.ADMIN && user.role !== Role.SYNDIC) {
    throw new HttpError(403, "Seuls ADMIN et SYNDIC peuvent créer une annonce");
  }
  const body = await parseBody(req, announcementCreateSchema);
  const residenceIds = await getAnnouncementResidenceIds(user);
  if (residenceIds && !residenceIds.includes(body.residence)) {
    throw new HttpError(403, "Vous ne gérez pas cette résidence");
  }
  const residence = await Residence.exists({ _id: body.residence });
  if (!residence) throw new HttpError(404, "Résidence introuvable");

  const scheduledAt = body.status === AnnouncementStatus.SCHEDULED ? body.scheduledAt : null;
  const publishedAt = body.status === AnnouncementStatus.PUBLISHED
    ? new Date()
    : scheduledAt ?? new Date();
  const announcement = await Announcement.create({
    ...body,
    author: user.id,
    publishedAt,
    scheduledAt,
  });
  if (announcement.status === AnnouncementStatus.PUBLISHED && announcement.publishedAt <= new Date()) {
    await notifyAnnouncementPublished(
      announcement,
      `announcement:${announcement._id}:published:${announcement.publishedAt.toISOString()}`,
      user.id
    );
  }
  return json(announcement, 201);
});
````

### `app/api/announcements/stats/route.ts`

````typescript
import mongoose from "mongoose";
import type { PipelineStage } from "mongoose";
import type { NextRequest } from "next/server";
import { HttpError, json } from "@/lib/api";
import { getAnnouncementResidenceIds } from "@/lib/announcements/access";
import { publishDueAnnouncements } from "@/lib/announcements/publication";
import { getEligibleResidentIdsByResidence, getReadCountsByAnnouncement } from "@/lib/announcements/readStats";
import { withAuth, type AuthUser } from "@/lib/auth-guard";
import { Announcement } from "@/models/Announcement";
import { Residence } from "@/models/Residence";
import { AnnouncementStatus, Role } from "@/types/enums";

interface StatsAnnouncementRow {
  _id: mongoose.Types.ObjectId;
  residence: mongoose.Types.ObjectId;
}

export const GET = withAuth(async (_req: NextRequest, user: AuthUser) => {
  if (user.role !== Role.ADMIN && user.role !== Role.SYNDIC) {
    throw new HttpError(403, "Statistiques réservées à ADMIN et SYNDIC");
  }
  const residenceIds = await getAnnouncementResidenceIds(user);
  if (!residenceIds && user.role !== Role.ADMIN) throw new HttpError(403, "Accès interdit");
  await publishDueAnnouncements(residenceIds);
  const filter = residenceIds
    ? { residence: { $in: residenceIds.map((id) => new mongoose.Types.ObjectId(id)) } }
    : {};
  const now = new Date();
  const rows = await Announcement.aggregate([
    { $match: filter as PipelineStage.Match["$match"] },
    {
      $group: {
        _id: null,
        total: { $sum: 1 },
        published: {
          $sum: {
            $cond: [
              {
                $and: [
                  { $or: [{ $eq: ["$status", AnnouncementStatus.PUBLISHED] }, { $eq: [{ $type: "$status" }, "missing"] }] },
                  { $or: [{ $eq: [{ $ifNull: ["$scheduledAt", null] }, null] }, { $lte: ["$scheduledAt", now] }] },
                  { $or: [{ $eq: [{ $ifNull: ["$expiresAt", null] }, null] }, { $gt: ["$expiresAt", now] }] },
                ],
              },
              1,
              0,
            ],
          },
        },
        scheduled: { $sum: { $cond: [{ $eq: ["$status", AnnouncementStatus.SCHEDULED] }, 1, 0] } },
        drafts: { $sum: { $cond: [{ $eq: ["$status", AnnouncementStatus.DRAFT] }, 1, 0] } },
        expired: {
          $sum: {
            $cond: [
              {
                $and: [
                  { $or: [{ $eq: ["$status", AnnouncementStatus.PUBLISHED] }, { $eq: [{ $type: "$status" }, "missing"] }] },
                  { $ne: [{ $ifNull: ["$expiresAt", null] }, null] },
                  { $lte: ["$expiresAt", now] },
                ],
              },
              1,
              0,
            ],
          },
        },
      },
    },
  ]);
  const eligibleAnnouncementFilter: Record<string, unknown> = {
    ...filter,
    $and: [
      {
        $or: [
          { status: AnnouncementStatus.PUBLISHED },
          { status: { $exists: false } },
        ],
      },
      {
        $or: [
          { audience: { $in: ["RESIDENTS", "ALL"] } },
          { audience: { $exists: false } },
        ],
      },
      { $or: [{ scheduledAt: null }, { scheduledAt: { $exists: false } }, { scheduledAt: { $lte: now } }] },
      { $or: [{ expiresAt: null }, { expiresAt: { $exists: false } }, { expiresAt: { $gt: now } }] },
    ],
  };
  const published = await Announcement.aggregate<StatsAnnouncementRow>([
    { $match: eligibleAnnouncementFilter as PipelineStage.Match["$match"] },
    { $project: { _id: 1, residence: 1 } },
  ]);
  const publishedResidenceIds = [...new Set(published.map((item) => String(item.residence)))];
  const eligibleByResidence = await getEligibleResidentIdsByResidence(publishedResidenceIds);
  const readsByAnnouncement = await getReadCountsByAnnouncement(published.map((item) => ({
      id: String(item._id),
      residenceId: String(item.residence),
    })), eligibleByResidence);

  const totalsByResidence = new Map<string, { eligible: number; read: number }>();
  let eligibleTotal = 0;
  let readTotal = 0;
  for (const announcement of published) {
    const residenceId = String(announcement.residence);
    const eligible = eligibleByResidence.get(residenceId)?.size ?? 0;
    const reads = Math.min(readsByAnnouncement.get(String(announcement._id)) ?? 0, eligible);
    const total = totalsByResidence.get(residenceId) ?? { eligible: 0, read: 0 };
    total.eligible += eligible;
    total.read += reads;
    totalsByResidence.set(residenceId, total);
    eligibleTotal += eligible;
    readTotal += reads;
  }
  const residenceNames = await Residence.find({
    _id: { $in: [...totalsByResidence.keys()] },
  }).select("name").lean();
  const nameByResidence = new Map(residenceNames.map((item) => [String(item._id), item.name]));

  return json({
    total: rows[0]?.total ?? 0,
    published: rows[0]?.published ?? 0,
    scheduled: rows[0]?.scheduled ?? 0,
    drafts: rows[0]?.drafts ?? 0,
    expired: rows[0]?.expired ?? 0,
    averageReadPercentage: eligibleTotal ? Math.round((readTotal / eligibleTotal) * 100) : 0,
    byResidence: [...totalsByResidence].map(([id, value]) => ({
      residenceId: id,
      residenceName: nameByResidence.get(id) ?? "Résidence",
      readCount: value.read,
      eligibleReadCount: value.eligible,
      readPercentage: value.eligible ? Math.round((value.read / value.eligible) * 100) : 0,
    })),
  });
});
````

### `app/api/announcements/upload/route.ts`

````typescript
import { randomUUID } from "crypto";
import { mkdir, writeFile } from "fs/promises";
import path from "path";
import type { NextRequest } from "next/server";
import mongoose from "mongoose";
import { HttpError, json } from "@/lib/api";
import { withAuth, type AuthUser } from "@/lib/auth-guard";
import { getAnnouncementResidenceIds } from "@/lib/announcements/access";
import { Residence } from "@/models/Residence";
import { Role } from "@/types/enums";

const MAX_FILE_SIZE = 5 * 1024 * 1024;
const MIME_INFO = {
  "application/pdf": { extensions: ["pdf"], extension: "pdf", signature: (buffer: Buffer) => buffer.subarray(0, 5).toString() === "%PDF-" },
  "image/jpeg": { extensions: ["jpg", "jpeg"], extension: "jpg", signature: (buffer: Buffer) => buffer[0] === 0xff && buffer[1] === 0xd8 && buffer[2] === 0xff },
  "image/png": { extensions: ["png"], extension: "png", signature: (buffer: Buffer) => buffer.subarray(0, 8).equals(Buffer.from([137, 80, 78, 71, 13, 10, 26, 10])) },
} as const;

export const POST = withAuth(async (req: NextRequest, user: AuthUser) => {
  if (user.role !== Role.ADMIN && user.role !== Role.SYNDIC) {
    throw new HttpError(403, "Téléversement réservé à ADMIN et SYNDIC");
  }
  const formData = await req.formData();
  const file = formData.get("file");
  const residence = formData.get("residence");
  if (!file || typeof file === "string" || typeof residence !== "string" || !mongoose.isValidObjectId(residence)) {
    throw new HttpError(400, "Fichier ou résidence manquant");
  }
  if (file.size < 1 || file.size > MAX_FILE_SIZE) {
    throw new HttpError(400, "Chaque fichier doit faire au maximum 5 Mo");
  }
  const residenceIds = await getAnnouncementResidenceIds(user);
  if (residenceIds && !residenceIds.includes(residence)) {
    throw new HttpError(403, "Vous ne gérez pas cette résidence");
  }
  if (!await Residence.exists({ _id: residence })) throw new HttpError(404, "Résidence introuvable");

  const mimeType = file.type as keyof typeof MIME_INFO;
  const info = MIME_INFO[mimeType];
  const fileExtension = path.extname(file.name).slice(1).toLowerCase();
  const validExtension = mimeType === "image/jpeg"
    ? fileExtension === "jpg" || fileExtension === "jpeg"
    : info && fileExtension === info.extension;
  if (!info || !validExtension) {
    throw new HttpError(400, "Formats acceptés : PDF, JPG, JPEG et PNG");
  }
  const buffer = Buffer.from(await file.arrayBuffer());
  if (!info.signature(buffer)) throw new HttpError(400, "Le contenu du fichier ne correspond pas à son type");

  const fileId = `${randomUUID()}.${info.extension}`;
  const directory = path.join(process.cwd(), "data", "private-announcements");
  await mkdir(directory, { recursive: true });
  await writeFile(path.join(directory, fileId), buffer, { flag: "wx" });
  return json({
    attachment: {
      name: path.basename(file.name).slice(0, 180),
      url: `/api/announcements/attachments/${fileId}`,
      mimeType,
      size: buffer.byteLength,
    },
  }, 201);
});
````

### `app/api/auth/register/route.ts`

````typescript
import type { NextRequest } from "next/server";
import { HttpError, handle, isDuplicateKeyError, json, parseBody } from "@/lib/api";
import { User } from "@/models/User";
import { registerSchema } from "@/lib/validations/auth";
import { hashPassword } from "@/lib/password";
import { Role } from "@/types/enums";

/**
 * POST /api/auth/register
 * Inscription publique d'un utilisateur.
 * Règle de sécurité stricte : Le rôle créé est STRICTEMENT et TOUJOURS Role.RESIDENT.
 * Tout champ "role" transmis par le client est sciemment ignoré (protection anti-élévation de privilèges).
 */
export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
  return handle(async () => {
    const data = await parseBody(req, registerSchema);
    const normalizedEmail = data.email.toLowerCase().trim();

    const existing = await User.findOne({ email: normalizedEmail }).lean();
    if (existing) {
      throw new HttpError(409, "Un compte avec cette adresse email existe déjà");
    }

    const passwordHash = await hashPassword(data.password);

    try {
      const user = await User.create({
        name: data.name,
        email: normalizedEmail,
        passwordHash,
        phone: data.phone,
        role: Role.RESIDENT, // Toujours RESIDENT
        isActive: true,
      });

      return json(
        {
          id: user._id.toString(),
          name: user.name,
          email: user.email,
          role: user.role,
        },
        201
      );
    } catch (err) {
      if (isDuplicateKeyError(err)) {
        throw new HttpError(409, "Un compte avec cette adresse email existe déjà");
      }
      throw err;
    }
  });
}
````

### `app/api/charges/generate/route.ts`

````typescript
import type { NextRequest } from "next/server";
import { HttpError, isValidObjectId, json, parseBody } from "@/lib/api";
import { withAuth, getSyndicResidenceIds, type AuthUser } from "@/lib/auth-guard";
import { Apartment } from "@/models/Apartment";
import { Charge } from "@/models/Charge";
import { Residence } from "@/models/Residence";
import { Role, ChargeStatus } from "@/types/enums";
import { z } from "zod";
import { objectId, period } from "@/lib/validations/common";

const generateChargesSchema = z.object({
  residenceId: objectId,
  period,
  totalBudget: z.number().positive("Le budget total doit être strictement positif"),
  dueDate: z.string().optional(),
});

/**
 * POST /api/charges/generate
 * Génère automatiquement les charges d'une résidence pour un mois donné,
 * au prorata des tantièmes de chaque lot, sans doublon sur {apartment, period}.
 * Rôles : ADMIN, SYNDIC
 */
export const POST = withAuth(
  async (req: NextRequest, user: AuthUser) => {
    const data = await parseBody(req, generateChargesSchema);

    if (!isValidObjectId(data.residenceId)) {
      throw new HttpError(400, "Identifiant de résidence invalide");
    }

    // Vérification des droits du syndic
    if (user.role === Role.SYNDIC) {
      const syndicResidences = await getSyndicResidenceIds(user.id);
      if (!syndicResidences.includes(data.residenceId)) {
        throw new HttpError(403, "Vous n'administrez pas cette copropriété");
      }
    }

    const residence = await Residence.findById(data.residenceId).lean();
    if (!residence) {
      throw new HttpError(404, "Résidence introuvable");
    }

    const apartments = await Apartment.find({ residence: data.residenceId }).lean();
    if (apartments.length === 0) {
      throw new HttpError(400, "Aucun lot enregistré dans cette résidence");
    }

    const totalShares = apartments.reduce((sum, apt) => sum + (Number(apt.shares) || 0), 0);
    if (totalShares <= 0) {
      throw new HttpError(
        400,
        "La somme des tantièmes de la résidence est nulle. Veuillez renseigner les tantièmes des lots."
      );
    }

    // Date d'échéance par défaut : le 15 du mois de la période
    const [yearStr, monthStr] = data.period.split("-");
    const year = parseInt(yearStr, 10);
    const month = parseInt(monthStr, 10);
    const defaultDueDate = new Date(year, month - 1, 15);
    const dueDate = data.dueDate ? new Date(data.dueDate) : defaultDueDate;

    let createdCount = 0;
    let skippedCount = 0;

    for (const apt of apartments) {
      // Détection de doublon sur { apartment, period }
      const exists = await Charge.findOne({
        apartment: apt._id,
        period: data.period,
      }).lean();

      if (exists) {
        skippedCount++;
        continue;
      }

      // Calcul au prorata strict des tantièmes
      const amount = Math.round(((data.totalBudget * (apt.shares || 0)) / totalShares) * 100) / 100;

      await Charge.create({
        apartment: apt._id,
        period: data.period,
        amount,
        paidAmount: 0,
        dueDate,
        status: ChargeStatus.PENDING,
      });

      createdCount++;
    }

    return json(
      {
        message: `${createdCount} charge(s) générée(s) pour la période ${data.period}`,
        createdCount,
        skippedCount,
        totalApartments: apartments.length,
        totalBudget: data.totalBudget,
        period: data.period,
      },
      201
    );
  },
  { roles: [Role.ADMIN, Role.SYNDIC] }
);
````

### `app/api/cron/publish-announcements/route.ts`

````typescript
import { timingSafeEqual } from "node:crypto";
import type { NextRequest } from "next/server";
import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { connectDB } from "@/lib/db";
import { publishDueAnnouncements } from "@/lib/announcements/publication";

function isValidCronSecret(request: NextRequest): boolean {
  const expectedSecret = process.env.CRON_SECRET;
  const authorization = request.headers.get("authorization");

  if (!expectedSecret || !authorization || !authorization.startsWith("Bearer ")) {
    return false;
  }

  const expected = Buffer.from(expectedSecret);
  const provided = Buffer.from(authorization.slice(7));

  if (expected.length !== provided.length) return false;
  return timingSafeEqual(expected, provided);
}

export async function POST(request: NextRequest) {
  if (!isValidCronSecret(request)) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }

  try {
    await connectDB();
    const publishedCount = await publishDueAnnouncements(null);
    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,
      message: "Scheduled announcements processed",
      publishedCount,
    });
  } catch {
    console.error("[cron] Announcement publication failed");
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "Announcement publication failed" },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}
````

### `app/api/dashboard/route.ts`

````typescript
import type { NextRequest } from "next/server";
import mongoose from "mongoose";
import { json } from "@/lib/api";
import { withAuth, type AuthUser, getSyndicResidenceIds, getResidentApartmentIds, getResidentResidenceIds } from "@/lib/auth-guard";
import { Role, IncidentStatus, ChargeStatus, AnnouncementAudience, AnnouncementStatus } from "@/types/enums";
import { Apartment } from "@/models/Apartment";
import { Charge } from "@/models/Charge";
import { Payment } from "@/models/Payment";
import { Expense } from "@/models/Expense";
import { Incident } from "@/models/Incident";
import { Announcement } from "@/models/Announcement";
import { User } from "@/models/User";
import { Residence } from "@/models/Residence";
import AnnouncementRead from "@/models/AnnouncementRead";
import { Notification } from "@/models/Notification";
import { getTechnicianResidenceIds } from "@/lib/auth-guard";
import { publishedAnnouncementFilter } from "@/lib/announcements/visibility";
import { getEligibleResidentIdsByResidence, getReadCountsByAnnouncement } from "@/lib/announcements/readStats";
import { publishDueAnnouncements } from "@/lib/announcements/publication";

/**
 * GET /api/dashboard
 * Endpoint unique retournant les métriques et chiffres adaptés selon le rôle connecté :
 * - ADMIN / SYNDIC : KPI (taux recouvrement, trésorerie, incidents ouverts, impayés) + graphiques
 * - RESIDENT : Ce que je dois, dernières annonces, mes incidents
 * - TECHNICIAN : Mes interventions (assignées, en cours, résolues)
 */
export const GET = withAuth(
  async (_req: NextRequest, user: AuthUser) => {
    // -------------------------------------------------------------
    // 1. SYNDIC & ADMIN
    // -------------------------------------------------------------
    if (user.role === Role.ADMIN || user.role === Role.SYNDIC) {
      let residenceFilter: Record<string, unknown> = {};
      let residenceIds: string[] = [];

      if (user.role === Role.SYNDIC) {
        residenceIds = await getSyndicResidenceIds(user.id);
        residenceFilter = { residence: { $in: residenceIds } };
      }
      await publishDueAnnouncements(user.role === Role.ADMIN ? null : residenceIds);

      // Lots de la copropriété
      const aptIds = await Apartment.find(residenceFilter).distinct("_id");
      const currentMonth = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 7);

      // Charges du mois et taux de recouvrement
      const [monthChargeSummary] = await Charge.aggregate<{ totalAmount: number; totalPaid: number }>([
        { $match: { apartment: { $in: aptIds }, period: currentMonth } },
        { $group: { _id: null, totalAmount: { $sum: "$amount" }, totalPaid: { $sum: "$paidAmount" } } },
      ]);
      const totalMonthAmount = monthChargeSummary?.totalAmount ?? 0;
      const totalMonthPaid = monthChargeSummary?.totalPaid ?? 0;

      const collectionRate =
        totalMonthAmount > 0
          ? Math.round((totalMonthPaid / totalMonthAmount) * 100)
          : 100;

      // Trésorerie = Recettes encaissées - Dépenses
      const chargeIds = await Charge.find({ apartment: { $in: aptIds } }).distinct("_id");
      const [paymentSum] = await Payment.aggregate<{ total: number }>([
        { $match: { charge: { $in: chargeIds } } },
        { $group: { _id: null, total: { $sum: "$amount" } } },
      ]);
      const [expenseSum] = await Expense.aggregate<{ total: number }>([
        { $match: residenceFilter },
        { $group: { _id: null, total: { $sum: "$amount" } } },
      ]);

      const totalPayments = paymentSum?.total || 0;
      const totalExpenses = expenseSum?.total || 0;
      const treasury = Math.round((totalPayments - totalExpenses) * 100) / 100;

      // Incidents ouverts
      const incFilter: Record<string, unknown> = {
        status: { $in: [IncidentStatus.REPORTED, IncidentStatus.ASSIGNED, IncidentStatus.IN_PROGRESS] },
      };
      if (user.role === Role.SYNDIC) incFilter.residence = { $in: residenceIds };
      const openIncidents = await Incident.countDocuments(incFilter);

      // Impayés globaux
      const [unpaidChargeSummary] = await Charge.aggregate<{ total: number }>([
        { $match: { apartment: { $in: aptIds }, status: { $in: [ChargeStatus.PENDING, ChargeStatus.PARTIAL, ChargeStatus.OVERDUE] } } },
        { $addFields: { remainingAmount: { $subtract: [{ $ifNull: ["$amount", 0] }, { $ifNull: ["$paidAmount", 0] }] } } },
        { $group: { _id: null, total: { $sum: { $cond: [{ $gt: ["$remainingAmount", 0] }, "$remainingAmount", 0] } } } },
      ]);
      const unpaidAmount = Math.round((unpaidChargeSummary?.total ?? 0) * 100) / 100;

      // Graphique 1 : Recettes vs Dépenses par mois (6 derniers mois)
      const months: string[] = [];
      const now = new Date();
      for (let i = 5; i >= 0; i--) {
        const d = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth() - i, 1);
        months.push(d.toISOString().slice(0, 7));
      }

      // Agrégation dépenses par mois
      const expensesByMonth = await Expense.aggregate<{ _id: string; total: number }>([
        { $match: residenceFilter },
        {
          $group: {
            _id: { $substr: [{ $dateToString: { date: "$expenseDate" } }, 0, 7] },
            total: { $sum: "$amount" },
          },
        },
      ]);
      const expMap = new Map(expensesByMonth.map((e) => [e._id, e.total]));

      // Agrégation paiements par mois
      const paymentsByMonth = await Payment.aggregate<{ _id: string; total: number }>([
        { $match: { charge: { $in: chargeIds } } },
        {
          $group: {
            _id: { $substr: [{ $dateToString: { date: "$paymentDate" } }, 0, 7] },
            total: { $sum: "$amount" },
          },
        },
      ]);
      const payMap = new Map(paymentsByMonth.map((p) => [p._id, p.total]));

      const financialByMonth = months.map((m) => {
        const dateObj = new Date(m + "-01");
        const monthLabel = dateObj.toLocaleDateString("fr-FR", { month: "short" });
        return {
          month: monthLabel,
          period: m,
          recettes: Math.round((payMap.get(m) || 0) * 100) / 100,
          depenses: Math.round((expMap.get(m) || 0) * 100) / 100,
        };
      });

      // Graphique 2 : Incidents par statut
      const managedIncidentFilter = user.role === Role.SYNDIC
        ? { residence: { $in: residenceIds } }
        : {};
      const [
        roleCounts,
        residenceCount,
        incidentCounts,
        publishedAnnouncementCount,
        scheduledAnnouncementCount,
        announcementTrendRows,
        urgentIncidents,
        latestAnnouncements,
        workloadRows,
        latestNotifications,
      ] = await Promise.all([
        user.role === Role.ADMIN
          ? User.aggregate<{ _id: string; count: number }>([
              { $match: { isActive: true } },
              { $group: { _id: "$role", count: { $sum: 1 } } },
            ])
          : Promise.resolve([]),
        Residence.countDocuments(user.role === Role.SYNDIC ? { _id: { $in: residenceIds } } : {}),
        Incident.aggregate<{ _id: string; count: number }>([
          { $match: managedIncidentFilter },
          { $group: { _id: "$status", count: { $sum: 1 } } },
        ]),
        Announcement.countDocuments({
          ...residenceFilter,
          ...publishedAnnouncementFilter(),
          status: AnnouncementStatus.PUBLISHED,
          publishedAt: { $lte: new Date() },
        }),
        Announcement.countDocuments({ ...residenceFilter, status: AnnouncementStatus.SCHEDULED }),
        Announcement.aggregate<{ _id: string; count: number }>([
          {
            $match: {
              ...residenceFilter,
              ...publishedAnnouncementFilter(),
              status: AnnouncementStatus.PUBLISHED,
              publishedAt: { $gte: new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth() - 5, 1), $lte: now },
            },
          },
          { $group: { _id: { $dateToString: { format: "%Y-%m", date: "$publishedAt" } }, count: { $sum: 1 } } },
        ]),
        Incident.aggregate<{
          _id: mongoose.Types.ObjectId;
          title: string;
          category: string;
          priority: string;
          status: string;
          createdAt: Date;
          residence: mongoose.Types.ObjectId;
          residenceName: string;
        }>([
          { $match: { ...managedIncidentFilter, status: { $ne: IncidentStatus.RESOLVED }, priority: { $in: ["URGENT", "HIGH"] } } },
          { $addFields: { priorityOrder: { $cond: [{ $eq: ["$priority", "URGENT"] }, 2, 1] } } },
          { $sort: { priorityOrder: -1, createdAt: 1 } },
          { $limit: 5 },
          {
            $lookup: {
              from: Residence.collection.name,
              localField: "residence",
              foreignField: "_id",
              pipeline: [{ $project: { name: 1 } }],
              as: "residenceDoc",
            },
          },
          { $addFields: { residenceName: { $ifNull: [{ $arrayElemAt: ["$residenceDoc.name", 0] }, ""] } } },
          { $project: { title: 1, category: 1, priority: 1, status: 1, createdAt: 1, residence: 1, residenceName: 1 } },
        ]),
        Announcement.find({
          ...residenceFilter,
          ...publishedAnnouncementFilter(),
          status: AnnouncementStatus.PUBLISHED,
          publishedAt: { $lte: new Date() },
        })
          .sort({ isPinned: -1, publishedAt: -1 })
          .limit(5)
          .select("title category priority audience publishedAt residence")
          .populate<{ residence: { _id: mongoose.Types.ObjectId; name: string } }>({ path: "residence", select: "name" })
          .lean(),
        Incident.aggregate<{ _id: string; assigned: number; inProgress: number; resolved: number }>([
          { $match: { ...managedIncidentFilter, assignedTo: { $ne: null } } },
          { $group: {
            _id: "$assignedTo",
            assigned: { $sum: { $cond: [{ $eq: ["$status", IncidentStatus.ASSIGNED] }, 1, 0] } },
            inProgress: { $sum: { $cond: [{ $eq: ["$status", IncidentStatus.IN_PROGRESS] }, 1, 0] } },
            resolved: { $sum: { $cond: [{ $eq: ["$status", IncidentStatus.RESOLVED] }, 1, 0] } },
          } },
          { $limit: 20 },
        ]),
        Notification.find({ recipient: user.id })
          .sort({ createdAt: -1 })
          .limit(5)
          .select("title message type isRead createdAt relatedResource")
          .lean(),
      ]);
      const statusMap = new Map(incidentCounts.map((item) => [item._id, item.count]));
      const usersByRole = new Map(roleCounts.map((item) => [item._id, item.count]));
      let scopedResidentCount = usersByRole.get(Role.RESIDENT) ?? 0;
      let scopedTechnicianCount = usersByRole.get(Role.TECHNICIAN) ?? 0;
      if (user.role === Role.SYNDIC) {
        const [eligibleByResidence, assignedTechnicianIds] = await Promise.all([
          getEligibleResidentIdsByResidence(residenceIds),
          Incident.distinct("assignedTo", {
            residence: { $in: residenceIds },
            assignedTo: { $ne: null },
          }),
        ]);
        scopedResidentCount = [...eligibleByResidence.values()].reduce((sum, ids) => sum + ids.size, 0);
        scopedTechnicianCount = await User.countDocuments({
          _id: { $in: assignedTechnicianIds },
          role: Role.TECHNICIAN,
          isActive: true,
        });
      }
      const workloadUsers = await User.find({
        _id: { $in: workloadRows.map((item) => item._id) },
        isActive: true,
      }).select("_id name").lean();
      const workloadNames = new Map(workloadUsers.map((item) => [String(item._id), item.name]));
      const eligibleResidents = await getEligibleResidentIdsByResidence(
        [...new Set(latestAnnouncements.map((item) => String(item.residence && typeof item.residence === "object" ? item.residence._id : item.residence)))]
      );
      const readsByAnnouncement = await getReadCountsByAnnouncement(
        latestAnnouncements.map((announcement) => ({
          id: String(announcement._id),
          residenceId: String(announcement.residence && typeof announcement.residence === "object"
            ? announcement.residence._id
            : announcement.residence),
        })),
        eligibleResidents
      );
      const announcementOverview = latestAnnouncements.map((announcement) => {
        const residenceId = String(announcement.residence && typeof announcement.residence === "object" ? announcement.residence._id : announcement.residence);
        const eligible = announcement.audience === AnnouncementAudience.TECHNICIANS
          ? null
          : eligibleResidents.get(residenceId)?.size ?? 0;
        const reads = eligible === null
          ? 0
          : Math.min(readsByAnnouncement.get(String(announcement._id)) ?? 0, eligible);
        return {
          id: String(announcement._id),
          title: announcement.title,
          category: announcement.category,
          priority: announcement.priority,
          publishedAt: announcement.publishedAt,
          residence: announcement.residence && typeof announcement.residence === "object" ? announcement.residence.name : "",
          readCount: reads,
          eligibleReadCount: eligible,
          readPercentage: eligible === null ? null : eligible ? Math.round((reads / eligible) * 100) : 0,
        };
      });

      const incidentsByStatus = [
        { status: "REPORTED", label: "Signalé", count: statusMap.get(IncidentStatus.REPORTED) || 0, color: "#38bdf8" },
        { status: "ASSIGNED", label: "Assigné", count: statusMap.get(IncidentStatus.ASSIGNED) || 0, color: "#f59e0b" },
        { status: "IN_PROGRESS", label: "En cours", count: statusMap.get(IncidentStatus.IN_PROGRESS) || 0, color: "#6366f1" },
        { status: "RESOLVED", label: "Résolu", count: statusMap.get(IncidentStatus.RESOLVED) || 0, color: "#10b981" },
      ];
      const announcementTrendCounts = new Map(announcementTrendRows.map((item) => [item._id, item.count]));
      const announcementByMonth = months.map((period) => ({
        month: new Date(`${period}-01T00:00:00.000Z`).toLocaleDateString("fr-FR", { month: "short" }),
        period,
        count: announcementTrendCounts.get(period) ?? 0,
      }));

      const technicianWorkload = workloadRows.map((item) => ({
        technicianId: String(item._id),
        name: workloadNames.get(String(item._id)) ?? "Technicien",
        assigned: item.assigned,
        inProgress: item.inProgress,
        resolved: item.resolved,
        currentWorkload: item.assigned + item.inProgress,
      })).filter((item) => item.name);

      const overview = {
        residences: residenceCount,
        users: user.role === Role.ADMIN
          ? [...usersByRole.values()].reduce((sum, count) => sum + count, 0)
          : scopedResidentCount + scopedTechnicianCount + (user.role === Role.SYNDIC ? 1 : 0),
        residents: scopedResidentCount,
        technicians: scopedTechnicianCount,
        incidents: [...statusMap.values()].reduce((sum, count) => sum + count, 0),
        reported: statusMap.get(IncidentStatus.REPORTED) ?? 0,
        assigned: statusMap.get(IncidentStatus.ASSIGNED) ?? 0,
        inProgress: statusMap.get(IncidentStatus.IN_PROGRESS) ?? 0,
        resolved: statusMap.get(IncidentStatus.RESOLVED) ?? 0,
        urgent: await Incident.countDocuments({ ...managedIncidentFilter, status: { $ne: IncidentStatus.RESOLVED }, priority: "URGENT" }),
        rejectedResolutions: await Incident.countDocuments({
          ...managedIncidentFilter,
          status: { $ne: IncidentStatus.RESOLVED },
          resolutionRejectedAt: { $exists: true },
        }),
        publishedAnnouncements: publishedAnnouncementCount,
        scheduledAnnouncements: scheduledAnnouncementCount,
        urgentIncidents: urgentIncidents.map((item) => ({
          id: String(item._id),
          title: item.title,
          category: item.category,
          priority: item.priority,
          status: item.status,
          createdAt: item.createdAt,
          residence: item.residenceName,
        })),
        recentAnnouncements: announcementOverview,
        technicianWorkload,
        unreadNotifications: await Notification.countDocuments({ recipient: user.id, isRead: false }),
      };

      return json({
        role: user.role,
        kpi: {
          period: currentMonth,
          collectionRate,
          treasury,
          openIncidents,
          unpaidAmount,
          totalApartments: aptIds.length,
        },
        charts: {
          financialByMonth,
          incidentsByStatus,
          announcementByMonth,
        },
        overview,
        latestNotifications,
      });
    }

    // -------------------------------------------------------------
    // 2. RESIDENT
    // -------------------------------------------------------------
    if (user.role === Role.RESIDENT) {
      const aptIds = await getResidentApartmentIds(user.id);
      const resIds = await getResidentResidenceIds(user.id);
      await publishDueAnnouncements(resIds);

      // Ce que je dois
      const unpaidChargeFilter = {
        apartment: { $in: aptIds },
        status: { $in: [ChargeStatus.PENDING, ChargeStatus.PARTIAL, ChargeStatus.OVERDUE] },
      };
      const [unpaidCharges, unpaidChargeSummary] = await Promise.all([
        Charge.find(unpaidChargeFilter)
          .populate("apartment", "number floor")
          .sort({ dueDate: 1 })
          .limit(5)
          .select("period dueDate amount paidAmount status apartment")
          .lean(),
        Charge.aggregate<{ total: number }>([
          { $match: unpaidChargeFilter },
          { $addFields: { remainingAmount: { $subtract: [{ $ifNull: ["$amount", 0] }, { $ifNull: ["$paidAmount", 0] }] } } },
          { $group: { _id: null, total: { $sum: { $cond: [{ $gt: ["$remainingAmount", 0] }, "$remainingAmount", 0] } } } },
        ]),
      ]);
      const totalDue = Math.round((unpaidChargeSummary[0]?.total ?? 0) * 100) / 100;


      // Dernières annonces
      const announcementFilter = {
        residence: { $in: resIds },
        ...publishedAnnouncementFilter(),
        audience: { $in: [AnnouncementAudience.RESIDENTS, AnnouncementAudience.ALL] },
      };
      const [announcements, incidents, incidentCounts, notifications, apartments, unreadNotificationCount] = await Promise.all([
        Announcement.find(announcementFilter)
          .sort({ isPinned: -1, priority: -1, publishedAt: -1 })
          .limit(6)
          .select("title content category priority isPinned publishedAt residence")
          .lean(),
        Incident.find({ reportedBy: user.id })
          .sort({ createdAt: -1, reportedAt: -1 })
          .limit(6)
          .select("title category priority status reportedAt createdAt updatedAt resolutionSubmittedAt")
          .lean(),
        Incident.aggregate<{ _id: string; count: number }>([
          { $match: { reportedBy: new mongoose.Types.ObjectId(user.id) } },
          { $group: { _id: "$status", count: { $sum: 1 } } },
        ]),
        Notification.find({ recipient: user.id })
          .sort({ createdAt: -1 })
          .limit(5)
          .select("title message type isRead createdAt relatedResource")
          .lean(),
        Apartment.find({ _id: { $in: aptIds } })
          .select("number floor residence")
          .populate<{ residence: { _id: mongoose.Types.ObjectId; name: string; city: string } }>({ path: "residence", select: "name city" })
          .lean(),
        Notification.countDocuments({ recipient: user.id, isRead: false }),
      ]);
      const announcementIds = announcements.map((item) => item._id);
      const readAnnouncementIds = new Set((await AnnouncementRead.distinct("announcement", {
        resident: user.id,
        announcement: { $in: announcementIds },
      })).map(String));
      const unreadAnnouncementRows = await Announcement.aggregate<{ count: number }>([
        { $match: announcementFilter },
        {
          $lookup: {
            from: AnnouncementRead.collection.name,
            let: { announcementId: "$_id" },
            pipeline: [
              {
                $match: {
                  $expr: {
                    $and: [
                      { $eq: ["$announcement", "$$announcementId"] },
                      { $eq: ["$resident", new mongoose.Types.ObjectId(user.id)] },
                    ],
                  },
                },
              },
              { $limit: 1 },
              { $project: { _id: 1 } },
            ],
            as: "readRecord",
          },
        },
        { $match: { readRecord: { $size: 0 } } },
        { $count: "count" },
      ]);
      const unreadAnnouncements = unreadAnnouncementRows[0]?.count ?? 0;
      const countByStatus = new Map(incidentCounts.map((item) => [item._id, item.count]));
      const totalIncidents = [...countByStatus.values()].reduce((sum, count) => sum + count, 0);
      const openIncidents = totalIncidents - (countByStatus.get(IncidentStatus.RESOLVED) ?? 0);
      const residenceDetails = [...new Map(apartments.flatMap((apartment) => {
        if (!apartment.residence || typeof apartment.residence !== "object") return [];
        return [[String(apartment.residence._id), {
          id: String(apartment.residence._id),
          name: apartment.residence.name,
          city: apartment.residence.city,
        }] as const];
      })).values()];

      return json({
        role: user.role,
        overview: {
          total: totalIncidents,
          reported: countByStatus.get(IncidentStatus.REPORTED) ?? 0,
          assigned: countByStatus.get(IncidentStatus.ASSIGNED) ?? 0,
          inProgress: countByStatus.get(IncidentStatus.IN_PROGRESS) ?? 0,
          resolved: countByStatus.get(IncidentStatus.RESOLVED) ?? 0,
          urgent: await Incident.countDocuments({ reportedBy: user.id, status: { $ne: IncidentStatus.RESOLVED }, priority: "URGENT" }),
          open: openIncidents,
          unreadAnnouncements,
          unreadNotifications: unreadNotificationCount,
        },
        residences: residenceDetails,
        whatIOwe: {
          totalDue,
          unpaidCharges: unpaidCharges.map((charge) => ({
            ...charge,
            remaining: Math.max(0, charge.amount - (charge.paidAmount ?? 0)),
          })),
        },
        latestAnnouncements: announcements.map((announcement) => ({
          ...announcement,
          _id: String(announcement._id),
          isRead: readAnnouncementIds.has(String(announcement._id)),
        })),
        latestNotifications: notifications,
        myIncidents: {
          items: incidents.map((incident) => ({
            ...incident,
            _id: String(incident._id),
            latestUpdate: incident.updatedAt ?? incident.createdAt ?? incident.reportedAt,
          })),
          total: totalIncidents,
          open: openIncidents,
        },
      });
    }

    // -------------------------------------------------------------
    // 3. TECHNICIAN
    // -------------------------------------------------------------
    if (user.role === Role.TECHNICIAN) {
      const assignedFilter = { assignedTo: new mongoose.Types.ObjectId(user.id) };
      const technicianResidenceIds = await getTechnicianResidenceIds(user.id);
      await publishDueAnnouncements(technicianResidenceIds);
      const announcementFilter = {
        residence: { $in: technicianResidenceIds },
        ...publishedAnnouncementFilter(),
        audience: { $in: [AnnouncementAudience.TECHNICIANS, AnnouncementAudience.ALL] },
      };
      const [incidentCounts, pendingInterventions, resolvedInterventions, latestAnnouncements, notifications, unreadNotificationCount] = await Promise.all([
        Incident.aggregate<{ _id: string; count: number }>([
          { $match: assignedFilter },
          { $group: { _id: "$status", count: { $sum: 1 } } },
        ]),
        Incident.aggregate([
          { $match: { ...assignedFilter, status: { $ne: IncidentStatus.RESOLVED } } },
          {
            $addFields: {
              priorityOrder: {
                $switch: {
                  branches: [
                    { case: { $eq: ["$priority", "URGENT"] }, then: 4 },
                    { case: { $eq: ["$priority", "HIGH"] }, then: 3 },
                    { case: { $eq: ["$priority", "MEDIUM"] }, then: 2 },
                    { case: { $eq: ["$priority", "LOW"] }, then: 1 },
                  ],
                  default: 0,
                },
              },
            },
          },
          { $sort: { priorityOrder: -1, createdAt: 1 } },
          { $limit: 8 },
          { $lookup: { from: Residence.collection.name, localField: "residence", foreignField: "_id", as: "residenceDoc" } },
          { $unwind: { path: "$residenceDoc", preserveNullAndEmptyArrays: true } },
          { $lookup: { from: Apartment.collection.name, localField: "apartment", foreignField: "_id", as: "apartmentDoc" } },
          { $unwind: { path: "$apartmentDoc", preserveNullAndEmptyArrays: true } },
          {
            $addFields: {
                residence: {
                  $cond: [
                    { $ifNull: ["$residenceDoc._id", false] },
                    { name: "$residenceDoc.name", city: "$residenceDoc.city" },
                    null,
                  ],
                },
                apartment: {
                  $cond: [
                    { $ifNull: ["$apartmentDoc._id", false] },
                    { number: "$apartmentDoc.number", floor: "$apartmentDoc.floor" },
                    null,
                  ],
                },
              },
          },
          { $project: { priorityOrder: 0, residenceDoc: 0, apartmentDoc: 0 } },
        ]),
        Incident.find({ ...assignedFilter, status: IncidentStatus.RESOLVED })
          .sort({ resolvedAt: -1, updatedAt: -1 })
          .limit(5)
          .select("title category priority status resolvedAt resolutionDescription")
          .populate({ path: "residence", select: "name city" })
          .lean(),
        Announcement.find(announcementFilter)
          .sort({ isPinned: -1, publishedAt: -1 })
          .limit(5)
          .select("title category priority isPinned publishedAt residence")
          .populate({ path: "residence", select: "name city" })
          .lean(),
        Notification.find({ recipient: user.id })
          .sort({ createdAt: -1 })
          .limit(5)
          .select("title message type isRead createdAt relatedResource")
          .lean(),
        Notification.countDocuments({ recipient: user.id, isRead: false }),
      ]);
      const countByStatus = new Map(incidentCounts.map((item) => [item._id, item.count]));
      const assignedCount = countByStatus.get(IncidentStatus.ASSIGNED) ?? 0;
      const inProgressCount = countByStatus.get(IncidentStatus.IN_PROGRESS) ?? 0;
      const resolvedCount = countByStatus.get(IncidentStatus.RESOLVED) ?? 0;
      const totalCount = [...countByStatus.values()].reduce((sum, count) => sum + count, 0);
      const urgentCount = await Incident.countDocuments({
        ...assignedFilter,
        status: { $ne: IncidentStatus.RESOLVED },
        priority: "URGENT",
      });
      const average = await Incident.aggregate<{ averageHours: number }>([
        { $match: { ...assignedFilter, status: IncidentStatus.RESOLVED, resolvedAt: { $ne: null } } },
        { $group: { _id: null, averageHours: { $avg: { $divide: [{ $subtract: ["$resolvedAt", "$createdAt"] }, 3_600_000] } } } },
      ]);

      return json({
        role: user.role,
        overview: {
          total: totalCount,
          assigned: assignedCount,
          inProgress: inProgressCount,
          resolved: resolvedCount,
          urgent: urgentCount,
          averageResolutionHours: Math.round((average[0]?.averageHours ?? 0) * 10) / 10,
          awaitingReview: await Incident.countDocuments({
            ...assignedFilter,
            resolutionSubmittedAt: { $exists: true },
            resolutionConfirmedAt: { $exists: false },
            resolutionRejectedAt: { $exists: false },
          }),
          unreadNotifications: unreadNotificationCount,
        },
        myInterventions: {
          pending: pendingInterventions,
          recentResolved: resolvedInterventions,
          counts: {
            assigned: assignedCount,
            inProgress: inProgressCount,
            resolved: resolvedCount,
            urgent: urgentCount,
            total: totalCount,
          },
        },
        latestAnnouncements,
        latestNotifications: notifications,
      });
    }

    return json({ role: user.role, message: "Aucune donnée spécifique pour ce rôle" });
  },
  { roles: [Role.ADMIN, Role.SYNDIC, Role.RESIDENT, Role.TECHNICIAN] }
);
````

### `app/api/documents/upload/route.ts`

````typescript
import type { NextRequest } from "next/server";
import { writeFile, mkdir } from "fs/promises";
import path from "path";
import { HttpError, json } from "@/lib/api";
import { withAuth, type AuthUser } from "@/lib/auth-guard";
import { Role } from "@/types/enums";

const MAX_FILE_SIZE = 5 * 1024 * 1024; // 5 Mo
const ALLOWED_MIME_TYPES = new Set([
  "application/pdf",
  "image/jpeg",
  "image/png",
  "image/webp",
]);

const EXTENSIONS: Record<string, string> = {
  "application/pdf": ".pdf",
  "image/jpeg": ".jpg",
  "image/png": ".png",
  "image/webp": ".webp",
};

/**
 * POST /api/documents/upload
 * Téléversement simple d'un fichier (PDF ou image, max 5 Mo).
 * Stocké dans public/uploads/ avec validation de type et de taille côté serveur.
 */
export const POST = withAuth(
  async (req: NextRequest, _user: AuthUser) => {
    const contentType = req.headers.get("content-type") || "";

    let buffer: Buffer;
    let mimeType: string;
    let originalName = "document";

    if (contentType.includes("multipart/form-data")) {
      const formData = await req.formData();
      const file = formData.get("file");

      if (!file || typeof file === "string") {
        throw new HttpError(400, "Fichier manquant dans le champ 'file'");
      }

      const blob = file as File;
      mimeType = blob.type || "application/octet-stream";
      originalName = blob.name || "document";

      if (blob.size > MAX_FILE_SIZE) {
        throw new HttpError(400, "Le fichier dépasse la taille maximale autorisée (5 Mo)");
      }

      const arrayBuffer = await blob.arrayBuffer();
      buffer = Buffer.from(arrayBuffer);
    } else if (contentType.includes("application/json")) {
      const body = await req.json().catch(() => ({}));
      const base64Data = body.base64 || body.file;
      mimeType = body.mimeType || "";
      originalName = body.filename || "document";

      if (!base64Data || typeof base64Data !== "string") {
        throw new HttpError(400, "Contenu base64 manquant");
      }

      // Extraction du data URL si présent : data:image/png;base64,xxxx
      const match = base64Data.match(/^data:([^;]+);base64,(.+)$/);
      let rawBase64 = base64Data;
      if (match) {
        mimeType = mimeType || match[1];
        rawBase64 = match[2];
      }

      buffer = Buffer.from(rawBase64, "base64");
      if (buffer.length > MAX_FILE_SIZE) {
        throw new HttpError(400, "Le fichier dépasse la taille maximale autorisée (5 Mo)");
      }
    } else {
      throw new HttpError(400, "Format de requête non supporté (attendu: multipart/form-data ou JSON)");
    }

    if (!ALLOWED_MIME_TYPES.has(mimeType)) {
      throw new HttpError(
        400,
        `Type de fichier non autorisé (${mimeType}). Formats acceptés : PDF, JPEG, PNG, WEBP.`
      );
    }

    // Répertoire cible public/uploads
    const uploadsDir = path.join(process.cwd(), "public", "uploads");
    await mkdir(uploadsDir, { recursive: true });

    const ext = EXTENSIONS[mimeType] || path.extname(originalName) || ".bin";
    const filename = `${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 9)}${ext}`;
    const filePath = path.join(uploadsDir, filename);

    await writeFile(filePath, buffer);

    const fileUrl = `/uploads/${filename}`;

    return json(
      {
        fileUrl,
        filename: originalName,
        size: buffer.length,
        mimeType,
      },
      201
    );
  },
  { roles: [Role.ADMIN, Role.SYNDIC] }
);
````
