### `lib/announcements/access.ts`

````typescript
import mongoose from "mongoose";
import { HttpError } from "@/lib/api";
import {
  getResidentResidenceIds,
  getSyndicResidenceIds,
  getTechnicianResidenceIds,
  type AuthUser,
} from "@/lib/auth-guard";
import { AnnouncementAudience, Role } from "@/types/enums";
import type { IAnnouncement } from "@/models/Announcement";
import { isAnnouncementVisible } from "./visibility";

export async function getAnnouncementResidenceIds(user: AuthUser): Promise<string[] | null> {
  switch (user.role) {
    case Role.ADMIN:
      return null;
    case Role.SYNDIC:
      return getSyndicResidenceIds(user.id);
    case Role.RESIDENT:
      return getResidentResidenceIds(user.id);
    case Role.TECHNICIAN:
      return getTechnicianResidenceIds(user.id);
    default:
      throw new HttpError(403, "Rôle non autorisé");
  }
}

export function announcementAudienceForRole(role: AuthUser["role"]) {
  switch (role) {
    case Role.RESIDENT:
      return {
        $in: [AnnouncementAudience.RESIDENTS, AnnouncementAudience.ALL],
      };
    case Role.TECHNICIAN:
      return { $in: [AnnouncementAudience.TECHNICIANS, AnnouncementAudience.ALL] };
    case Role.ADMIN:
    case Role.SYNDIC:
      return { $in: [AnnouncementAudience.RESIDENTS, AnnouncementAudience.TECHNICIANS, AnnouncementAudience.ALL] };
    default:
      throw new HttpError(403, "Rôle non autorisé");
  }
}

export function announcementAudienceFilter(role: AuthUser["role"]) {
  const audience = announcementAudienceForRole(role);
  return role === Role.RESIDENT
    ? { $or: [{ audience }, { audience: { $exists: false } }] }
    : { audience };
}

export function canManageAnnouncement(user: AuthUser, announcement: Pick<IAnnouncement, "residence">, residenceIds: string[] | null) {
  if (user.role === Role.ADMIN) return true;
  if (user.role !== Role.SYNDIC || !residenceIds) return false;
  return residenceIds.includes(String(announcement.residence));
}

export function canReadAnnouncement(
  user: AuthUser,
  announcement: Pick<IAnnouncement, "residence" | "audience" | "status" | "scheduledAt" | "publishedAt" | "expiresAt">,
  residenceIds: string[] | null,
  now = new Date()
) {
  if (!residenceIds && user.role !== Role.ADMIN) return false;
  if (residenceIds && !residenceIds.includes(String(announcement.residence))) return false;
  if (user.role === Role.ADMIN || user.role === Role.SYNDIC) return true;
  if (!isAnnouncementVisible(announcement, user.role, now)) return false;
  return mongoose.isValidObjectId(user.id);
}
````

### `lib/announcements/publication.ts`

````typescript
import mongoose from "mongoose";
import { Announcement } from "@/models/Announcement";
import { AnnouncementStatus } from "@/types/enums";
import { notifyAnnouncementPublished } from "@/lib/notifications/events";

export async function publishDueAnnouncements(residenceIds: string[] | null, now = new Date()) {
  if (residenceIds?.length === 0) return 0;
  const filter: Record<string, unknown> = {
    status: AnnouncementStatus.SCHEDULED,
    scheduledAt: { $lte: now },
    $or: [
      { expiresAt: null },
      { expiresAt: { $exists: false } },
      { expiresAt: { $gt: now } },
    ],
  };
  if (residenceIds) {
    filter.residence = {
      $in: residenceIds.map((id) => new mongoose.Types.ObjectId(id)),
    };
  }
  const due = await Announcement.find(filter).select("_id").lean();
  let publishedCount = 0;
  for (const { _id } of due) {
    const published = await Announcement.findOneAndUpdate(
      { ...filter, _id },
      [
        {
          $set: {
            status: AnnouncementStatus.PUBLISHED,
            publishedAt: "$scheduledAt",
            scheduledAt: null,
          },
        },
      ],
      { new: true }
    ).lean();
    if (published) {
      publishedCount += 1;
      await notifyAnnouncementPublished(
        published,
        `announcement:${published._id}:published:${new Date(published.publishedAt).toISOString()}`
      );
    }
  }
  return publishedCount;
}
````

### `lib/announcements/readStats.ts`

````typescript
import mongoose from "mongoose";
import { Apartment } from "@/models/Apartment";
import { Resident } from "@/models/Resident";
import { User } from "@/models/User";
import AnnouncementRead from "@/models/AnnouncementRead";
import { Role } from "@/types/enums";

export async function getEligibleResidentIdsByResidence(residenceIds: string[]) {
  const result = new Map<string, Set<string>>();
  if (residenceIds.length === 0) return result;

  const objectIds = residenceIds.map((id) => new mongoose.Types.ObjectId(id));
  const apartments = await Apartment.find({ residence: { $in: objectIds } })
    .select("_id residence owner")
    .lean();
  const apartmentIds = apartments.map((apartment) => apartment._id);
  const activeResidents = await Resident.find({
    apartment: { $in: apartmentIds },
    isActive: true,
    user: { $ne: null },
  }).select("apartment user").lean();

  const usersByResidence = new Map<string, Set<string>>();
  const apartmentResidence = new Map(apartments.map((apartment) => [
    String(apartment._id),
    String(apartment.residence),
  ]));
  for (const apartment of apartments) {
    const residenceId = String(apartment.residence);
    const users = usersByResidence.get(residenceId) ?? new Set<string>();
    if (apartment.owner) users.add(String(apartment.owner));
    usersByResidence.set(residenceId, users);
  }
  for (const resident of activeResidents) {
    if (!resident.user) continue;
    const residenceId = apartmentResidence.get(String(resident.apartment));
    if (!residenceId) continue;
    const users = usersByResidence.get(residenceId) ?? new Set<string>();
    users.add(String(resident.user));
    usersByResidence.set(residenceId, users);
  }

  const allUserIds = [...new Set([...usersByResidence.values()].flatMap((ids) => [...ids]))];
  const validUserIds = new Set((await User.distinct("_id", {
    _id: { $in: allUserIds },
    role: Role.RESIDENT,
    isActive: true,
  })).map(String));
  for (const residenceId of residenceIds) {
    result.set(residenceId, new Set(
      [...(usersByResidence.get(residenceId) ?? [])].filter((id) => validUserIds.has(id))
    ));
  }
  return result;
}

export async function getAnnouncementReadStats(announcementId: string, residenceId: string) {
  const eligibleByResidence = await getEligibleResidentIdsByResidence([residenceId]);
  const eligible = eligibleByResidence.get(residenceId) ?? new Set<string>();
  const readCount = eligible.size
    ? await AnnouncementRead.countDocuments({
        announcement: announcementId,
        resident: { $in: [...eligible].map((id) => new mongoose.Types.ObjectId(id)) },
      })
    : 0;
  const totalEligibleResidents = eligible.size;
  return {
    totalEligibleResidents,
    readCount,
    unreadCount: Math.max(0, totalEligibleResidents - readCount),
    readPercentage: totalEligibleResidents
      ? Math.round((readCount / totalEligibleResidents) * 100)
      : 0,
  };
}

export async function getReadCountsByAnnouncement(
  announcements: Array<{ id: string; residenceId: string }>,
  eligibleByResidence: Map<string, Set<string>>
) {
  if (announcements.length === 0) return new Map<string, number>();
  const ids = announcements.map((item) => item.id);
  const eligibleUsers = [...new Set(
    announcements.flatMap((item) => [...(eligibleByResidence.get(item.residenceId) ?? [])])
  )];
  if (eligibleUsers.length === 0) return new Map<string, number>();
  const residenceByAnnouncement = new Map(announcements.map((item) => [item.id, item.residenceId]));
  const rows = await AnnouncementRead.aggregate<{
    _id: { announcement: mongoose.Types.ObjectId; resident: mongoose.Types.ObjectId };
  }>([
    {
      $match: {
        announcement: { $in: ids.map((id) => new mongoose.Types.ObjectId(id)) },
        resident: { $in: eligibleUsers.map((id) => new mongoose.Types.ObjectId(id)) },
      },
    },
    { $group: { _id: { announcement: "$announcement", resident: "$resident" } } },
  ]);
  const counts = new Map<string, number>();
  for (const row of rows) {
    const announcementId = String(row._id.announcement);
    const residenceId = residenceByAnnouncement.get(announcementId);
    if (!residenceId || !eligibleByResidence.get(residenceId)?.has(String(row._id.resident))) continue;
    counts.set(announcementId, (counts.get(announcementId) ?? 0) + 1);
  }
  return counts;
}
````

### `lib/announcements/visibility.ts`

````typescript
import {
  AnnouncementAudience,
  AnnouncementStatus,
  Role,
  type AnnouncementAudience as AnnouncementAudienceType,
  type Role as RoleType,
} from "@/types/enums";

export interface AnnouncementVisibilityFields {
  status?: string;
  audience?: string;
  publishedAt?: Date | string | null;
  scheduledAt?: Date | string | null;
  expiresAt?: Date | string | null;
}

function toDate(value?: Date | string | null) {
  if (!value) return null;
  const parsed = value instanceof Date ? value : new Date(value);
  return Number.isNaN(parsed.getTime()) ? null : parsed;
}

export function isAnnouncementVisible(
  announcement: AnnouncementVisibilityFields,
  role: RoleType,
  now = new Date()
) {
  if (announcement.status && announcement.status !== AnnouncementStatus.PUBLISHED) return false;
  const audience = announcement.audience ?? AnnouncementAudience.RESIDENTS;
  const allowedAudience: AnnouncementAudienceType[] = role === Role.RESIDENT
    ? [AnnouncementAudience.RESIDENTS, AnnouncementAudience.ALL]
    : role === Role.TECHNICIAN
    ? [AnnouncementAudience.TECHNICIANS, AnnouncementAudience.ALL]
    : [AnnouncementAudience.RESIDENTS, AnnouncementAudience.TECHNICIANS, AnnouncementAudience.ALL];
  if (!allowedAudience.includes(audience as AnnouncementAudienceType)) return false;

  const publishDate = toDate(announcement.scheduledAt) ?? toDate(announcement.publishedAt);
  const expiresAt = toDate(announcement.expiresAt);
  return (!publishDate || publishDate <= now) && (!expiresAt || expiresAt > now);
}

export function publishedAnnouncementFilter(now = new Date()) {
  return {
    $and: [
      { $or: [{ status: AnnouncementStatus.PUBLISHED }, { status: { $exists: false } }] },
      {
        $or: [
          { scheduledAt: null },
          { scheduledAt: { $exists: false } },
          { scheduledAt: { $lte: now } },
        ],
      },
      {
        $or: [
          { expiresAt: null },
          { expiresAt: { $exists: false } },
          { expiresAt: { $gt: now } },
        ],
      },
    ],
  };
}
````

### `lib/api.ts`

````typescript
import { connection, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import mongoose from "mongoose";
import { z, ZodError } from "zod";
import { connectDB } from "@/lib/db";
import "@/models";

/** Forme standard d'une erreur renvoyée par l'API. */
export interface ApiErrorBody {
  error: string;
  details?: unknown;
}

/** Erreur métier avec code HTTP explicite (ex : 404 ressource introuvable). */
export class HttpError extends Error {
  constructor(
    public status: number,
    message: string,
    public details?: unknown
  ) {
    super(message);
  }
}

export function json<T>(data: T, status = 200) {
  return NextResponse.json<T>(data, { status });
}

/** Lit et valide le corps JSON d'une requête avec un schéma Zod. */
export async function parseBody<S extends z.ZodType>(req: Request, schema: S): Promise<z.infer<S>> {
  let raw: unknown;
  try {
    raw = await req.json();
  } catch {
    throw new HttpError(400, "Corps JSON invalide");
  }

  // Les formulaires envoient "" pour un champ facultatif laissé vide : on le traite
  // comme un champ absent pour que la validation Zod ne le rejette pas.
  if (raw && typeof raw === "object" && !Array.isArray(raw)) {
    raw = Object.fromEntries(
      Object.entries(raw as Record<string, unknown>).filter(([, value]) => value !== "")
    );
  }
  return schema.parse(raw);
}

export function isValidObjectId(id: string | null | undefined): id is string {
  return !!id && /^[a-f\d]{24}$/i.test(id);
}

/** Erreur MongoDB "duplicate key" (index unique violé). */
export function isDuplicateKeyError(err: unknown): err is { code: 11000; keyPattern?: Record<string, number> } {
  return typeof err === "object" && err !== null && (err as { code?: number }).code === 11000;
}

function toErrorResponse(err: unknown) {
  if (err instanceof HttpError) {
    return json<ApiErrorBody>({ error: err.message, details: err.details }, err.status);
  }
  if (err instanceof ZodError) {
    return json<ApiErrorBody>({ error: "Données invalides", details: z.flattenError(err) }, 400);
  }
  if (err instanceof mongoose.Error.ValidationError || err instanceof mongoose.Error.CastError) {
    return json<ApiErrorBody>({ error: "Données invalides", details: err.message }, 400);
  }
  if (isDuplicateKeyError(err)) {
    return json<ApiErrorBody>({ error: "Ressource déjà existante", details: err.keyPattern }, 409);
  }
  console.error("[API]", err);
  return json<ApiErrorBody>({ error: "Erreur interne du serveur" }, 500);
}

/**
 * Enveloppe commune des handlers :
 *  1. `connection()` : avec cacheComponents, indique à Next que la réponse dépend
 *     de la requête -> pas de prérendu au build (sinon il tenterait d'interroger MongoDB).
 *     Appelé hors du try pour ne pas intercepter le signal interne de Next.
 *  2. connexion MongoDB (mise en cache par lib/db.ts)
 *  3. conversion des erreurs en réponses 400 / 404 / 409 / 500
 */
export async function handle(fn: () => Promise<Response>): Promise<Response> {
  await connection();
  try {
    await connectDB();
    return await fn();
  } catch (err) {
    return toErrorResponse(err);
  }
}
````

### `lib/auth-guard.ts`

````typescript
import type { NextRequest } from "next/server";
import { auth } from "@/auth";
import { HttpError, handle, isValidObjectId } from "@/lib/api";
import { Role } from "@/types/enums";
import { Apartment } from "@/models/Apartment";
import { Resident } from "@/models/Resident";
import { Residence } from "@/models/Residence";
import { Incident } from "@/models/Incident";
import { User } from "@/models/User";
import { roleAccessStatus } from "@/lib/role-access";

export interface AuthUser {
  id: string;
  name?: string | null;
  email?: string | null;
  role: Role;
}

/**
 * Récupère l'utilisateur connecté via la session JWT Auth.js.
 * Lève une exception HttpError(401) si l'utilisateur n'est pas authentifié.
 */
export async function requireAuth(): Promise<AuthUser> {
  const session = await auth();
  if (!session?.user?.id || !isValidObjectId(session.user.id)) {
    throw new HttpError(401, "Authentification requise");
  }
  const account = await User.findById(session.user.id)
    .select("name email role isActive")
    .lean();
  if (!account || account.isActive === false) {
    throw new HttpError(401, "Session expirée ou compte désactivé");
  }
  if (!Object.values(Role).includes(account.role)) {
    throw new HttpError(403, "Rôle non autorisé");
  }
  return {
    id: String(account._id),
    name: account.name,
    email: account.email,
    role: account.role,
  };
}

/**
 * Vérifie que le rôle de l'utilisateur fait partie des rôles autorisés.
 * Lève une exception HttpError(403) si le rôle est insuffisant.
 */
export function requireRole(user: AuthUser, ...roles: Role[]): void {
  const status = roleAccessStatus(user.role, roles);
  if (status) {
    throw new HttpError(status, "Accès interdit : rôle insuffisant");
  }
}

/**
 * Wrapper de route API avec authentification et contrôle de rôle automatique.
 */
export function withAuth(
  handler: (req: NextRequest, user: AuthUser, context?: any) => Promise<Response>,
  options?: { roles?: Role[] }
) {
  return async (req: NextRequest, context?: any): Promise<Response> => {
    return handle(async () => {
      const user = await requireAuth();
      if (options?.roles && options.roles.length > 0) {
        requireRole(user, ...options.roles);
      }
      return handler(req, user, context);
    });
  };
}

/**
 * Récupère les identifiants d'appartements associés à un résident
 * (soit en tant que propriétaire, soit en tant que résident enregistré).
 */
export async function getResidentApartmentIds(userId: string): Promise<string[]> {
  const [owned, residentIn] = await Promise.all([
    Apartment.find({ owner: userId }).distinct("_id"),
    Resident.find({ user: userId, isActive: true }).distinct("apartment"),
  ]);
  const allIds = new Set<string>([
    ...owned.map((id) => id.toString()),
    ...residentIn.map((id) => id.toString()),
  ]);
  return Array.from(allIds);
}

/**
 * Récupère les résidences gérées par un syndic.
 */
export async function getSyndicResidenceIds(userId: string): Promise<string[]> {
  const residences = await Residence.find({ syndic: userId }).distinct("_id");
  return residences.map((id) => id.toString());
}

/**
 * Récupère les résidences auxquelles un résident est rattaché (via ses appartements).
 */
export async function getResidentResidenceIds(userId: string): Promise<string[]> {
  const aptIds = await getResidentApartmentIds(userId);
  const residences = await Apartment.find({ _id: { $in: aptIds } }).distinct("residence");
  return residences.map((id) => id.toString());
}

/**
 * Récupère les résidences associées à un technicien (via les incidents assignés).
 */
export async function getTechnicianResidenceIds(userId: string): Promise<string[]> {
  const residences = await Incident.find({ assignedTo: userId }).distinct("residence");
  return residences.map((id) => id.toString());
}
````

````typescript
import { createCrudRoutes } from "@/lib/crud/createCrudRoutes";
import { Announcement } from "@/models/Announcement";
import {
  getResidentResidenceIds,
  getSyndicResidenceIds,
  getTechnicianResidenceIds,
} from "@/lib/auth-guard";
import {
  announcementCreateSchema,
  announcementUpdateSchema,
} from "@/lib/validations/announcement";
import { Role } from "@/types/enums";
import { HttpError } from "@/lib/api";

/**
 * Configuration CRUD de référence pour l'entité Announcement.
 * - Lecture : tous les rôles autorisés de la résidence (ADMIN, SYNDIC, RESIDENT, TECHNICIAN).
 * - Écriture / Modification / Suppression : réservées aux rôles ADMIN et SYNDIC.
 * - Scope : restriction stricte aux résidences de l'utilisateur.
 * - Injection de sécurité : author = session.user.id garanti.
 */
export const announcementCrudRoutes = createCrudRoutes({
  model: Announcement,
  createSchema: announcementCreateSchema,
  updateSchema: announcementUpdateSchema,
  access: {
    read: [Role.ADMIN, Role.SYNDIC, Role.RESIDENT, Role.TECHNICIAN],
    create: [Role.ADMIN, Role.SYNDIC],
    update: [Role.ADMIN, Role.SYNDIC],
    delete: [Role.ADMIN, Role.SYNDIC],
  },
  searchFields: ["title", "content"],
  defaultSort: { isPinned: -1, publishedAt: -1 },
  populate: [
    { path: "author", select: "name" },
    { path: "residence", select: "name city" },
  ],
  filterFields: ["residence", "isPinned"],
  scope: async (user) => {
    // 1. ADMIN : accès global
    if (user.role === Role.ADMIN) {
      return {};
    }
    // 2. SYNDIC : résidences gérées
    if (user.role === Role.SYNDIC) {
      const residenceIds = await getSyndicResidenceIds(user.id);
      return { residence: { $in: residenceIds } };
    }
    // 3. RESIDENT : résidences où le résident possède ou occupe un appartement
    if (user.role === Role.RESIDENT) {
      const residenceIds = await getResidentResidenceIds(user.id);
      return { residence: { $in: residenceIds } };
    }
    // 4. TECHNICIAN : résidences liées aux interventions qui lui sont assignées
    if (user.role === Role.TECHNICIAN) {
      const residenceIds = await getTechnicianResidenceIds(user.id);
      return { residence: { $in: residenceIds } };
    }
    throw new HttpError(403, "Rôle non autorisé");
  },
  injectOnCreate: async (user) => {
    // Règle SyndicPro : author provient toujours de la session sécurisée
    return {
      author: user.id,
    };
  },
});
````

### `lib/crud/apartments.ts`

````typescript
import { createCrudRoutes } from "@/lib/crud/createCrudRoutes";
import { Apartment } from "@/models/Apartment";
import { Residence } from "@/models/Residence";
import { Charge } from "@/models/Charge";
import { getResidentApartmentIds, getSyndicResidenceIds } from "@/lib/auth-guard";
import { apartmentCreateSchema, apartmentUpdateSchema } from "@/lib/validations/apartment";
import { Role } from "@/types/enums";
import { HttpError } from "@/lib/api";

export const apartmentCrudRoutes = createCrudRoutes({
  model: Apartment,
  createSchema: apartmentCreateSchema,
  updateSchema: apartmentUpdateSchema,
  access: {
    read: [Role.ADMIN, Role.SYNDIC, Role.RESIDENT],
    create: [Role.ADMIN, Role.SYNDIC],
    update: [Role.ADMIN, Role.SYNDIC],
    delete: [Role.ADMIN, Role.SYNDIC],
  },
  searchFields: ["number"],
  defaultSort: { floor: 1, number: 1 },
  populate: [
    { path: "residence", select: "name city" },
    { path: "owner", select: "name email phone" },
  ],
  filterFields: ["residence", "isOccupied", "floor"],

  scope: async (user) => {
    // 1. ADMIN : accès global
    if (user.role === Role.ADMIN) {
      return {};
    }
    // 2. SYNDIC : appartements des résidences administrées
    if (user.role === Role.SYNDIC) {
      const syndicResidences = await getSyndicResidenceIds(user.id);
      return { residence: { $in: syndicResidences } };
    }
    // 3. RESIDENT : lecture de son propre appartement uniquement
    if (user.role === Role.RESIDENT) {
      const allowedAptIds = await getResidentApartmentIds(user.id);
      return { _id: { $in: allowedAptIds } };
    }
    return {};
  },

  beforeCreate: async (user, body) => {
    // Vérification des droits du syndic sur la résidence
    if (user.role === Role.SYNDIC) {
      const syndicResidences = await getSyndicResidenceIds(user.id);
      if (!syndicResidences.includes(String(body.residence))) {
        throw new HttpError(403, "Vous n'administrez pas cette résidence");
      }
    }

    // Vérification existence résidence
    if (!(await Residence.exists({ _id: body.residence }))) {
      throw new HttpError(404, "Résidence introuvable");
    }

    // Règle métier : Apartment unique sur {residence, number} avec erreur 409 lisible
    const existing = await Apartment.findOne({
      residence: body.residence,
      number: body.number,
    }).lean();

    if (existing) {
      throw new HttpError(
        409,
        `Un appartement portant le numéro "${body.number}" existe déjà dans cette résidence`
      );
    }
  },

  beforeDelete: async (id) => {
    // Règle métier : interdire la suppression d'un appartement qui a des charges
    const hasCharges = await Charge.exists({ apartment: id });
    if (hasCharges) {
      throw new HttpError(
        409,
        "Impossible de supprimer cet appartement car des charges y sont associées"
      );
    }
  },
});
````

### `lib/crud/charges.ts`

````typescript
import { createCrudRoutes } from "@/lib/crud/createCrudRoutes";
import { Charge } from "@/models/Charge";
import { Apartment } from "@/models/Apartment";
import { Payment } from "@/models/Payment";
import { getResidentApartmentIds, getSyndicResidenceIds } from "@/lib/auth-guard";
import { chargeCreateSchema, chargeUpdateSchema } from "@/lib/validations/charge";
import { Role } from "@/types/enums";
import { HttpError } from "@/lib/api";

export const chargeCrudRoutes = createCrudRoutes({
  model: Charge,
  createSchema: chargeCreateSchema,
  updateSchema: chargeUpdateSchema,
  access: {
    read: [Role.ADMIN, Role.SYNDIC, Role.RESIDENT],
    create: [Role.ADMIN, Role.SYNDIC],
    update: [Role.ADMIN, Role.SYNDIC],
    delete: [Role.ADMIN, Role.SYNDIC],
  },
  searchFields: ["period"],
  defaultSort: { dueDate: -1, period: -1 },
  populate: [
    {
      path: "apartment",
      select: "number floor shares residence",
      populate: { path: "residence", select: "name" },
    },
  ],
  filterFields: ["apartment", "period", "status"],
  dateField: "dueDate",
  exportPopulate: [{ path: "apartment", select: "number" }],
  exportColumns: [
    { key: "period", label: "Période" },
    { key: "apartment.number", label: "Appartement" },
    { key: "amount", label: "Montant" },
    { key: "paidAmount", label: "Payé" },
    { key: "dueDate", label: "Échéance" },
    { key: "status", label: "Statut" },
  ],

  scope: async (user) => {
    // 1. ADMIN : accès global
    if (user.role === Role.ADMIN) {
      return {};
    }
    // 2. SYNDIC : charges des appartements de ses résidences
    if (user.role === Role.SYNDIC) {
      const residenceIds = await getSyndicResidenceIds(user.id);
      const aptIds = await Apartment.find({ residence: { $in: residenceIds } }).distinct("_id");
      return { apartment: { $in: aptIds } };
    }
    // 3. RESIDENT : lecture de ses propres charges uniquement
    if (user.role === Role.RESIDENT) {
      const allowedAptIds = await getResidentApartmentIds(user.id);
      return { apartment: { $in: allowedAptIds } };
    }
    return {};
  },

  beforeCreate: async (user, body) => {
    const apt = await Apartment.findById(body.apartment).lean();
    if (!apt) throw new HttpError(404, "Appartement introuvable");

    if (user.role === Role.SYNDIC) {
      const residenceIds = await getSyndicResidenceIds(user.id);
      if (!residenceIds.includes(String(apt.residence))) {
        throw new HttpError(403, "Vous n'administrez pas la résidence de cet appartement");
      }
    }

    // Unicité { apartment, period }
    const existing = await Charge.findOne({
      apartment: body.apartment,
      period: body.period,
    }).lean();

    if (existing) {
      throw new HttpError(
        409,
        `Une charge pour la période "${body.period}" existe déjà pour cet appartement`
      );
    }
  },

  beforeDelete: async (id) => {
    const hasPayments = await Payment.exists({ charge: id });
    if (hasPayments) {
      throw new HttpError(
        409,
        "Impossible de supprimer une charge pour laquelle des paiements ont déjà été enregistrés"
      );
    }
  },
});
````

### `lib/crud/createCrudRoutes.ts`

````typescript
import type { NextRequest } from "next/server";
import type { Model } from "mongoose";

type MongoFilter<T = any> = Parameters<Model<T>["find"]>[0] | Record<string, any>;
import { z } from "zod";
import { HttpError, isValidObjectId, json, parseBody } from "@/lib/api";
import { withAuth, type AuthUser } from "@/lib/auth-guard";
import { Role } from "@/types/enums";

export interface CrudRouteConfig<T = any> {
  model: Model<T>;
  createSchema: z.ZodType<any>;
  updateSchema: z.ZodType<any>;
  access: {
    read?: Role[];
    create?: Role[];
    update?: Role[];
    delete?: Role[];
  };
  scope?: (user: AuthUser, req: NextRequest) => MongoFilter<T> | Promise<MongoFilter<T>>;
  injectOnCreate?: (
    user: AuthUser,
    body: any,
    req: NextRequest
  ) => Record<string, any> | Promise<Record<string, any>>;
  beforeCreate?: (user: AuthUser, body: any, req: NextRequest) => Promise<void> | void;
  beforeUpdate?: (
    id: string,
    user: AuthUser,
    body: Record<string, unknown>,
    req: NextRequest
  ) => Promise<void> | void;
  beforeDelete?: (id: string, user: AuthUser, req: NextRequest) => Promise<void> | void;
  afterCreate?: (doc: any, user: AuthUser, req: NextRequest) => Promise<void> | void;
  afterUpdate?: (doc: any, user: AuthUser, req: NextRequest) => Promise<void> | void;
  afterDelete?: (deletedDoc: any, user: AuthUser, req: NextRequest) => Promise<void> | void;
  afterList?: (data: any[], req: NextRequest, user: AuthUser) => Promise<any> | any;
  searchFields?: string[];
  defaultSort?: Record<string, 1 | -1> | string;
  allowedSortFields?: string[];
  populate?: any;
  filterFields?: string[];
  dateField?: string;
  exportColumns?: { key: string; label: string }[];
  exportPopulate?: any;
}

const DATE_PARAM_REGEX = /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/;

/**
 * Résout une valeur imbriquée via un chemin pointé (ex: "apartment.number").
 */
function resolveDotPath(obj: any, path: string): any {
  if (!obj || !path) return undefined;
  return path.split(".").reduce((acc, part) => (acc != null ? acc[part] : undefined), obj);
}

/**
 * Formate une valeur brute en chaîne pour une cellule CSV.
 */
function formatCsvValue(val: any): string {
  if (val === null || val === undefined) return "";
  if (val instanceof Date) {
    return isNaN(val.getTime()) ? "" : val.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
  }
  if (typeof val === "boolean") {
    return val ? "Oui" : "Non";
  }
  if (Array.isArray(val)) {
    return val.map((item) => formatCsvValue(item)).join(", ");
  }
  if (typeof val === "object") {
    // Support ObjectId ou objet ayant un toString dédié
    if (typeof val.toHexString === "function") {
      return val.toHexString();
    }
    if (typeof val.toString === "function" && val.toString !== Object.prototype.toString) {
      return String(val.toString());
    }
    return JSON.stringify(val);
  }
  return String(val);
}

/**
 * Protège contre l'injection de formules CSV et échappe les séparateurs/guillemets.
 */
function escapeCsvCell(raw: string): string {
  let cell = raw;
  if (/^[=+\-@]/.test(cell)) {
    cell = `'${cell}`;
  }
  if (/[;"\r\n]/.test(cell)) {
    return `"${cell.replace(/"/g, '""')}"`;
  }
  return cell;
}

/**
 * Extrait l'identifiant [id] de façon asynchrone pour compatibilité Next.js 15/16.
 */
async function extractId(context?: any): Promise<string | null> {
  if (!context?.params) return null;
  const p = await Promise.resolve(context.params);
  return p?.id || null;
}

/**
 * Fabrique de routes CRUD générique et réutilisable.
 * Produit { list, create, getOne, update, remove } sécurisés et typés.
 */
export function createCrudRoutes<T = any>(config: CrudRouteConfig<T>) {
  const allRoles = [Role.ADMIN, Role.SYNDIC, Role.RESIDENT, Role.TECHNICIAN];
  const readRoles = config.access.read || allRoles;
  const createRoles = config.access.create || [Role.ADMIN, Role.SYNDIC];
  const updateRoles = config.access.update || [Role.ADMIN, Role.SYNDIC];
  const deleteRoles = config.access.delete || [Role.ADMIN, Role.SYNDIC];

  // Construit le filtre combiné (scope + recherche ?q + filtres simples + plage de dates)
  async function buildFilter(req: NextRequest, user: AuthUser): Promise<MongoFilter<T>> {
    const { searchParams } = req.nextUrl;
    const filterConditions: MongoFilter<T>[] = [];

    // 1. Restriction de périmètre métier (Scope)
    if (config.scope) {
      const scopedFilter = await config.scope(user, req);
      if (scopedFilter && Object.keys(scopedFilter).length > 0) {
        filterConditions.push(scopedFilter);
      }
    }

    // 2. Recherche textuelle multi-champs (?q=...)
    const q = searchParams.get("q")?.trim();
    if (q && config.searchFields && config.searchFields.length > 0) {
      const regex = new RegExp(q.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, "\\$&"), "i");
      filterConditions.push({
        $or: config.searchFields.map((field) => ({ [field]: regex })),
      } as MongoFilter<T>);
    }

    // 3. Plage de dates (?from=YYYY-MM-DD&to=YYYY-MM-DD)
    if (config.dateField) {
      const fromParam = searchParams.get("from")?.trim();
      const toParam = searchParams.get("to")?.trim();
      const dateRange: Record<string, Date> = {};

      const fromDate = fromParam ? new Date(`${fromParam}T00:00:00.000Z`) : undefined;
      const toDate = toParam ? new Date(`${toParam}T23:59:59.999Z`) : undefined;
      if (fromParam && (
        !DATE_PARAM_REGEX.test(fromParam) ||
        Number.isNaN(fromDate?.getTime()) ||
        fromDate?.toISOString().slice(0, 10) !== fromParam
      )) {
        throw new HttpError(400, "Date de début invalide");
      }
      if (toParam && (
        !DATE_PARAM_REGEX.test(toParam) ||
        Number.isNaN(toDate?.getTime()) ||
        toDate?.toISOString().slice(0, 10) !== toParam
      )) {
        throw new HttpError(400, "Date de fin invalide");
      }
      if (fromDate && toDate && fromDate > toDate) {
        throw new HttpError(400, "La date de début doit précéder la date de fin");
      }
      if (toParam && toParam > new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)) {
        throw new HttpError(400, "La date de fin ne peut pas être dans le futur");
      }
      if (fromDate) dateRange.$gte = fromDate;
      if (toDate) dateRange.$lte = toDate;

      if (Object.keys(dateRange).length > 0) {
        filterConditions.push({ [config.dateField]: dateRange } as MongoFilter<T>);
      }
    }

    // 4. Filtres simples déclarés ou passés en query (?residence=...&status=...)
    searchParams.forEach((value, key) => {
      if (["page", "limit", "q", "sort", "from", "to"].includes(key)) return;
      if (config.filterFields && !config.filterFields.includes(key)) return;

      if (value === "true") {
        filterConditions.push({ [key]: true } as MongoFilter<T>);
      } else if (value === "false") {
        filterConditions.push({ [key]: false } as MongoFilter<T>);
      } else if (value !== "") {
        filterConditions.push({ [key]: value } as MongoFilter<T>);
      }
    });

    return filterConditions.length > 1
      ? { $and: filterConditions }
      : filterConditions[0] || {};
  }

  // Construit l'option de tri par défaut ou personnalisée (?sort=publishedAt:desc)
  function buildSort(req: NextRequest): any {
    const { searchParams } = req.nextUrl;
    let sortOption: any = config.defaultSort || { createdAt: -1 };
    const sortParam = searchParams.get("sort");
    if (sortParam) {
      const [field, direction] = sortParam.split(":");
      if (field && (!config.allowedSortFields || config.allowedSortFields.includes(field))) {
        sortOption = { [field]: direction === "asc" ? 1 : -1 };
      }
    }
    return sortOption;
  }

  // -------------------------------------------------------------
  // 1. LISTE (GET /api/<res>)
  // -------------------------------------------------------------
  const list = withAuth(
    async (req: NextRequest, user: AuthUser) => {
      const { searchParams } = req.nextUrl;

      // Pagination avec limite max 50
      const rawPage = parseInt(searchParams.get("page") || "1", 10);
      const rawLimit = parseInt(searchParams.get("limit") || "20", 10);
      const page = isNaN(rawPage) || rawPage < 1 ? 1 : rawPage;
      const limit = isNaN(rawLimit) || rawLimit < 1 ? 20 : Math.min(rawLimit, 50);
      const skip = (page - 1) * limit;

      const finalFilter = await buildFilter(req, user);
      const sortOption = buildSort(req);

      // Exécution parallèle des requêtes données + total
      const query = config.model.find(finalFilter).sort(sortOption).skip(skip).limit(limit);

      if (config.populate) {
        query.populate(config.populate);
      }

      const [data, total] = await Promise.all([
        query.lean(),
        config.model.countDocuments(finalFilter),
      ]);

      if (config.afterList) {
        const customResult = await config.afterList(data, req, user);
        if (customResult !== undefined) {
          return customResult instanceof Response ? customResult : json(customResult);
        }
      }

      return json({
        data,
        meta: {
          page,
          limit,
          total,
        },
      });
    },
    { roles: readRoles }
  );

  // -------------------------------------------------------------
  // 1b. EXPORT CSV (GET /api/<res>/export)
  // -------------------------------------------------------------
  const exportCsv = withAuth(
    async (req: NextRequest, user: AuthUser) => {
      if (!config.exportColumns || config.exportColumns.length === 0) {
        throw new HttpError(400, "Export non disponible pour cette ressource");
      }

      const finalFilter = await buildFilter(req, user);
      const sortOption = buildSort(req);

      const query = config.model.find(finalFilter).sort(sortOption).limit(5000);
      const populateOption = config.exportPopulate ?? config.populate;
      if (populateOption) {
        query.populate(populateOption);
      }

      const rows = (await query.lean()) as any[];

      const headerLine = config.exportColumns
        .map((col) => escapeCsvCell(col.label))
        .join(";");

      const dataLines = rows.map((row) =>
        config.exportColumns!
          .map((col) => {
            const rawVal = resolveDotPath(row, col.key);
            return escapeCsvCell(formatCsvValue(rawVal));
          })
          .join(";")
      );

      const csvBody = "\uFEFF" + [headerLine, ...dataLines].join("\r\n") + "\r\n";

      return new Response(csvBody, {
        headers: {
          "Content-Type": "text/csv; charset=utf-8",
          "Content-Disposition": `attachment; filename="export-${Date.now()}.csv"`,
          "Cache-Control": "no-store",
        },
      });
    },
    { roles: [Role.ADMIN, Role.SYNDIC] }
  );

  // -------------------------------------------------------------
  // 2. CRÉATION (POST /api/<res>)
  // -------------------------------------------------------------
  const create = withAuth(
    async (req: NextRequest, user: AuthUser) => {
      const parsedBody = await parseBody(req, config.createSchema);

      // Idempotence PWA : si clientId est fourni et présent dans le schéma
      const rawClientId = (parsedBody as any)?.clientId;
      if (rawClientId && config.model.schema.path("clientId")) {
        const existing = await config.model.findOne({ clientId: rawClientId }).lean();
        if (existing) {
          return json(existing, 200);
        }
      }

      // Forçage de champs côté serveur (ex: author: session.user.id)
      const injected = config.injectOnCreate
        ? await config.injectOnCreate(user, parsedBody, req)
        : {};

      const docData = {
        ...parsedBody,
        ...injected,
      };

      if (config.beforeCreate) {
        await config.beforeCreate(user, docData, req);
      }

      const created = await config.model.create(docData);
      const resDoc = created.toObject ? created.toObject() : created;
      if (config.afterCreate) {
        await config.afterCreate(resDoc, user, req);
      }
      return json(resDoc, 201);
    },
    { roles: createRoles }
  );

  // -------------------------------------------------------------
  // 3. OBTENIR UN ÉLÉMENT (GET /api/<res>/[id])
  // -------------------------------------------------------------
  const getOne = withAuth(
    async (req: NextRequest, user: AuthUser, context?: any) => {
      const id = await extractId(context);
      if (!isValidObjectId(id)) {
        throw new HttpError(400, "Identifiant invalide");
      }

      const filterConditions: MongoFilter<T>[] = [{ _id: id } as MongoFilter<T>];

      if (config.scope) {
        const scopedFilter = await config.scope(user, req);
        if (scopedFilter && Object.keys(scopedFilter).length > 0) {
          filterConditions.push(scopedFilter);
        }
      }

      const finalFilter: MongoFilter<T> =
        filterConditions.length > 1
          ? { $and: filterConditions }
          : filterConditions[0];

      const query = config.model.findOne(finalFilter);
      if (config.populate) {
        query.populate(config.populate);
      }

      const item = await query.lean();
      if (!item) {
        throw new HttpError(404, "Ressource introuvable");
      }

      return json(item, 200);
    },
    { roles: readRoles }
  );

  // -------------------------------------------------------------
  // 4. MISE À JOUR (PATCH /api/<res>/[id])
  // -------------------------------------------------------------
  const update = withAuth(
    async (req: NextRequest, user: AuthUser, context?: any) => {
      const id = await extractId(context);
      if (!isValidObjectId(id)) {
        throw new HttpError(400, "Identifiant invalide");
      }

      const parsedBody = await parseBody(req, config.updateSchema);

      if (config.beforeUpdate) {
        await config.beforeUpdate(id, user, parsedBody, req);
      }

      const filterConditions: MongoFilter<T>[] = [{ _id: id } as MongoFilter<T>];

      if (config.scope) {
        const scopedFilter = await config.scope(user, req);
        if (scopedFilter && Object.keys(scopedFilter).length > 0) {
          filterConditions.push(scopedFilter);
        }
      }

      const finalFilter: MongoFilter<T> =
        filterConditions.length > 1
          ? { $and: filterConditions }
          : filterConditions[0];

      const updated = await config.model
        .findOneAndUpdate(finalFilter, { $set: parsedBody }, { new: true, runValidators: true })
        .lean();

      if (!updated) {
        throw new HttpError(404, "Ressource introuvable ou modification non autorisée");
      }

      if (config.afterUpdate) {
        await config.afterUpdate(updated, user, req);
      }

      return json(updated, 200);
    },
    { roles: updateRoles }
  );

  // -------------------------------------------------------------
  // 5. SUPPRESSION (DELETE /api/<res>/[id])
  // -------------------------------------------------------------
  const remove = withAuth(
    async (req: NextRequest, user: AuthUser, context?: any) => {
      const id = await extractId(context);
      if (!isValidObjectId(id)) {
        throw new HttpError(400, "Identifiant invalide");
      }

      const filterConditions: MongoFilter<T>[] = [{ _id: id } as MongoFilter<T>];

      if (config.scope) {
        const scopedFilter = await config.scope(user, req);
        if (scopedFilter && Object.keys(scopedFilter).length > 0) {
          filterConditions.push(scopedFilter);
        }
      }

      const finalFilter: MongoFilter<T> =
        filterConditions.length > 1
          ? { $and: filterConditions }
          : filterConditions[0];

      if (config.beforeDelete) {
        await config.beforeDelete(id, user, req);
      }

      const deleted = await config.model.findOneAndDelete(finalFilter).lean();

      if (!deleted) {
        throw new HttpError(404, "Ressource introuvable ou suppression non autorisée");
      }

      if (config.afterDelete) {
        await config.afterDelete(deleted, user, req);
      }

      return json({ success: true, message: "Ressource supprimée avec succès" }, 200);
    },
    { roles: deleteRoles }
  );

  return {
    list,
    create,
    getOne,
    update,
    remove,
    exportCsv,
  };
}
````

### `lib/crud/incidents.ts`

````typescript
import { createCrudRoutes } from "@/lib/crud/createCrudRoutes";
import { Incident } from "@/models/Incident";
import { Residence } from "@/models/Residence";
import {
  getResidentApartmentIds,
  getResidentResidenceIds,
  getSyndicResidenceIds,
} from "@/lib/auth-guard";
import { incidentCreateSchema, incidentEditSchema } from "@/lib/validations/incident";
import { Role } from "@/types/enums";
import { HttpError } from "@/lib/api";
import { recordIncidentHistory } from "@/lib/incidents/recordHistory";
import { notifyIncidentHistory } from "@/lib/notifications/events";
import { computeAndStoreEmbedding } from "@/lib/ai/similarity";
import { GEMINI_MODEL } from "@/lib/ai/gemini";
import { TriageSchema } from "@/lib/ai/triage";
import {
  INCIDENT_CREATE_ROLES,
  INCIDENT_READ_ROLES,
  isResidenceManagedBySyndic,
  technicianIncidentScope,
} from "@/lib/incidents/access-policy";

export const incidentCrudRoutes = createCrudRoutes({
  model: Incident,
  createSchema: incidentCreateSchema,
  updateSchema: incidentEditSchema,
  access: {
    read: [...INCIDENT_READ_ROLES],
    create: [...INCIDENT_CREATE_ROLES],
    update: [Role.ADMIN, Role.SYNDIC],
    delete: [Role.ADMIN, Role.SYNDIC],
  },
  searchFields: ["title", "description"],
  defaultSort: { reportedAt: -1 },
  allowedSortFields: ["reportedAt", "createdAt", "priority", "status"],
  populate: [
    { path: "residence", select: "name city" },
    { path: "apartment", select: "number floor" },
    { path: "reportedBy", select: "name" },
    { path: "assignedTo", select: "name" },
  ],
  filterFields: ["residence", "category", "priority", "status", "assignedTo"],
  dateField: "createdAt",
  exportColumns: [
    { key: "title", label: "Réclamation" },
    { key: "category", label: "Catégorie" },
    { key: "priority", label: "Priorité" },
    { key: "status", label: "Statut" },
    { key: "residence.name", label: "Résidence" },
    { key: "assignedTo.name", label: "Technicien" },
    { key: "createdAt", label: "Date de création" },
  ],
  exportPopulate: [
    { path: "residence", select: "name" },
    { path: "assignedTo", select: "name" },
  ],

  scope: async (user) => {
    // 1. ADMIN : accès global
    if (user.role === Role.ADMIN) {
      return {};
    }
    // 2. SYNDIC : incidents de ses résidences
    if (user.role === Role.SYNDIC) {
      const residenceIds = await getSyndicResidenceIds(user.id);
      return { residence: { $in: residenceIds } };
    }
    // 3. TECHNICIAN : uniquement les incidents qui lui sont assignés
    if (user.role === Role.TECHNICIAN) {
      return technicianIncidentScope(user.id);
    }
    // 4. RESIDENT : uniquement ses incidents signalés
    if (user.role === Role.RESIDENT) {
      return { reportedBy: user.id };
    }
    return {};
  },

  injectOnCreate: async (user, body) => {
    // Règle de sécurité stricte : reportedBy est TOUJOURS session.user.id
    const parsedTriage = TriageSchema.safeParse(body.aiTriage);
    const aiTriage = parsedTriage.success
      ? {
          category: parsedTriage.data.category,
          priority: parsedTriage.data.priority,
          specialty: parsedTriage.data.specialty,
          probableCause: parsedTriage.data.probableCause,
          safetyRisk: parsedTriage.data.safetyRisk,
          confidence: parsedTriage.data.confidence,
          model: process.env.GEMINI_API_KEY
            ? GEMINI_MODEL
            : process.env.GROQ_MODEL ?? "openai/gpt-oss-120b",
        }
      : undefined;
    return {
      reportedBy: user.id,
      syncedAt: new Date(),
      ...(aiTriage ? { aiTriage } : {}),
    };
  },

  beforeCreate: async (user, body) => {
    const residenceExists = await Residence.exists({ _id: body.residence });
    if (!residenceExists) {
      throw new HttpError(404, "Résidence introuvable");
    }

    if (user.role === Role.SYNDIC) {
      const syndicResidences = await getSyndicResidenceIds(user.id);
      if (!isResidenceManagedBySyndic(String(body.residence), syndicResidences)) {
        throw new HttpError(403, "Vous n'administrez pas cette résidence");
      }
    }

    if (user.role === Role.RESIDENT) {
      const residentResidences = await getResidentResidenceIds(user.id);
      if (!residentResidences.includes(String(body.residence))) {
        throw new HttpError(
          403,
          "Vous ne pouvez pas signaler un incident pour une résidence qui n'est pas la vôtre"
        );
      }
      if (body.apartment) {
        const allowedAptIds = await getResidentApartmentIds(user.id);
        if (!allowedAptIds.includes(String(body.apartment))) {
          throw new HttpError(
            403,
            "Vous ne pouvez pas signaler un incident pour un appartement qui n'est pas le vôtre"
          );
        }
      }
    }
  },
  afterCreate: async (doc, user) => {
    void computeAndStoreEmbedding(String(doc._id), {
      title: doc.title,
      description: doc.description,
    }).catch((error: unknown) => {
      console.warn("[ai] failed to schedule incident embedding", error);
    });
    const history = await recordIncidentHistory({
      incidentId: doc._id,
      actorId: user.id,
      action: "CREATED",
      description: "Incident signalé",
    });
    await notifyIncidentHistory(String(history._id), String(doc._id), "CREATED", user.id);
  },
});
````

### `lib/crud/payments.ts`

````typescript
import mongoose from "mongoose";
import { createCrudRoutes } from "@/lib/crud/createCrudRoutes";
import { Payment } from "@/models/Payment";
import { Charge } from "@/models/Charge";
import { Apartment } from "@/models/Apartment";
import { getResidentApartmentIds, getSyndicResidenceIds } from "@/lib/auth-guard";
import { paymentCreateSchema, paymentUpdateSchema } from "@/lib/validations/payment";
import { Role } from "@/types/enums";
import { HttpError } from "@/lib/api";

/**
 * Helper qui recalcule et persiste le montant payé et le statut d'une charge
 * à partir de la somme réelle de tous ses paiements.
 */
export async function recalculateCharge(chargeId: string | mongoose.Types.ObjectId): Promise<void> {
  const cId = new mongoose.Types.ObjectId(String(chargeId));
  const [agg] = await Payment.aggregate<{ total: number }>([
    { $match: { charge: cId } },
    { $group: { _id: null, total: { $sum: "$amount" } } },
  ]);
  const charge = await Charge.findById(cId);
  if (!charge) return;
  charge.paidAmount = Math.round((agg?.total ?? 0) * 100) / 100;
  charge.updateStatus();
  await charge.save();
}

export const paymentCrudRoutes = createCrudRoutes({
  model: Payment,
  createSchema: paymentCreateSchema,
  updateSchema: paymentUpdateSchema,
  access: {
    read: [Role.ADMIN, Role.SYNDIC, Role.RESIDENT],
    create: [Role.ADMIN, Role.SYNDIC],
    update: [Role.ADMIN, Role.SYNDIC],
    delete: [Role.ADMIN, Role.SYNDIC],
  },
  searchFields: ["receiptNumber"],
  defaultSort: { paymentDate: -1, createdAt: -1 },
  populate: [
    {
      path: "charge",
      select: "period amount paidAmount status apartment",
      populate: { path: "apartment", select: "number floor residence", populate: { path: "residence", select: "name" } },
    },
    { path: "receivedBy", select: "name email" },
  ],
  filterFields: ["charge", "method"],
  dateField: "paymentDate",
  exportPopulate: [
    {
      path: "charge",
      select: "period apartment",
      populate: {
        path: "apartment",
        select: "number residence",
        populate: { path: "residence", select: "name" },
      },
    },
    { path: "receivedBy", select: "name" },
  ],
  exportColumns: [
    { key: "receiptNumber", label: "N° reçu" },
    { key: "paymentDate", label: "Date" },
    { key: "amount", label: "Montant" },
    { key: "method", label: "Mode" },
    { key: "charge.period", label: "Période" },
    { key: "charge.apartment.number", label: "Appartement" },
    { key: "charge.apartment.residence.name", label: "Résidence" },
    { key: "receivedBy.name", label: "Encaissé par" },
  ],

  scope: async (user) => {
    // 1. ADMIN : accès global
    if (user.role === Role.ADMIN) {
      return {};
    }
    // 2. SYNDIC : paiements des résidences administrées
    if (user.role === Role.SYNDIC) {
      const residenceIds = await getSyndicResidenceIds(user.id);
      const aptIds = await Apartment.find({ residence: { $in: residenceIds } }).distinct("_id");
      const chargeIds = await Charge.find({ apartment: { $in: aptIds } }).distinct("_id");
      return { charge: { $in: chargeIds } };
    }
    // 3. RESIDENT : paiements rattachés à ses propres charges uniquement
    if (user.role === Role.RESIDENT) {
      const allowedAptIds = await getResidentApartmentIds(user.id);
      const chargeIds = await Charge.find({ apartment: { $in: allowedAptIds } }).distinct("_id");
      return { charge: { $in: chargeIds } };
    }
    return {};
  },

  injectOnCreate: async (user, body) => {
    // Règle de sécurité stricte : receivedBy est TOUJOURS session.user.id
    // Génère receiptNumber de façon unique (REC-AAAAMMJJ-xxxxxx aléatoire)
    const d = new Date();
    const ymd = d.toISOString().slice(0, 10).replace(/-/g, "");
    const rand = Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8).toUpperCase();
    const receiptNumber =
      body.receiptNumber && body.receiptNumber.trim().length > 0
        ? body.receiptNumber
        : `REC-${ymd}-${rand}`;

    return {
      receivedBy: user.id,
      receiptNumber,
      syncedAt: new Date(),
    };
  },

  beforeCreate: async (user, body) => {
    const charge = await Charge.findById(body.charge);
    if (!charge) {
      throw new HttpError(404, "Charge introuvable");
    }

    if (user.role === Role.SYNDIC) {
      const apt = await Apartment.findById(charge.apartment).lean();
      if (apt) {
        const residenceIds = await getSyndicResidenceIds(user.id);
        if (!residenceIds.includes(String(apt.residence))) {
          throw new HttpError(403, "Vous n'administrez pas la résidence de cette charge");
        }
      }
    }

    // Règle métier : refuse un montant supérieur au reste à payer
    const remaining = Math.round((charge.amount - (charge.paidAmount || 0)) * 100) / 100;
    if (body.amount > remaining + 0.001) {
      throw new HttpError(
        400,
        `Le montant saisi (${body.amount.toFixed(2)} €) dépasse le reste à payer de cette charge (${remaining.toFixed(2)} €)`
      );
    }
  },

  afterUpdate: async (payment) => {
    if (payment?.charge) {
      await recalculateCharge(payment.charge);
    }
  },

  afterDelete: async (payment) => {
    if (payment?.charge) {
      await recalculateCharge(payment.charge);
    }
  },
});
````

````typescript
import { createCrudRoutes } from "@/lib/crud/createCrudRoutes";
import { Residence } from "@/models/Residence";
import { Apartment } from "@/models/Apartment";
import { Charge } from "@/models/Charge";
import { Incident } from "@/models/Incident";
import { getResidentApartmentIds, getSyndicResidenceIds } from "@/lib/auth-guard";
import { residenceCreateSchema, residenceUpdateSchema } from "@/lib/validations/residence";
import { Role, IncidentStatus } from "@/types/enums";
import { HttpError, json } from "@/lib/api";

const currentPeriod = () => new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 7);

export const residenceCrudRoutes = createCrudRoutes({
  model: Residence,
  createSchema: residenceCreateSchema,
  updateSchema: residenceUpdateSchema,
  access: {
    read: [Role.ADMIN, Role.SYNDIC, Role.RESIDENT],
    create: [Role.ADMIN, Role.SYNDIC],
    update: [Role.ADMIN, Role.SYNDIC],
    delete: [Role.ADMIN, Role.SYNDIC],
  },
  searchFields: ["name", "city", "address"],
  defaultSort: { name: 1 },
  populate: [{ path: "syndic", select: "name email phone" }],
  filterFields: ["city", "syndic"],

  scope: async (user) => {
    if (user.role === Role.ADMIN) {
      return {};
    }
    if (user.role === Role.SYNDIC) {
      const syndicResidences = await getSyndicResidenceIds(user.id);
      return { _id: { $in: syndicResidences } };
    }
    if (user.role === Role.RESIDENT) {
      const residentAptIds = await getResidentApartmentIds(user.id);
      const residentResidenceIds = await Apartment.find({
        _id: { $in: residentAptIds },
      }).distinct("residence");
      return { _id: { $in: residentResidenceIds } };
    }
    return {};
  },

  injectOnCreate: async (user, body) => {
    // Si un SYNDIC crée la résidence et ne précise pas d'autre syndic, il s'assigne automatiquement
    return {
      syndic: body.syndic || (user.role === Role.SYNDIC ? user.id : undefined),
    };
  },

  beforeDelete: async (id) => {
    // Règle métier : interdire la suppression d'une résidence qui a des charges
    const aptIds = await Apartment.find({ residence: id }).distinct("_id");
    const hasCharges = await Charge.exists({ apartment: { $in: aptIds } });
    if (hasCharges) {
      throw new HttpError(
        409,
        "Impossible de supprimer cette résidence car des charges y sont rattachées"
      );
    }
    const hasApartments = await Apartment.exists({ residence: id });
    if (hasApartments) {
      throw new HttpError(
        409,
        "Impossible de supprimer cette résidence car des appartements y sont rattachés"
      );
    }
  },

  afterList: async (data, req) => {
    // Compatibilité descendante pour le tableau de bord avec ?withStats=1
    if (req.nextUrl.searchParams.get("withStats") === "1") {
      const period = req.nextUrl.searchParams.get("period") ?? currentPeriod();
      const withStats = await Promise.all(
        data.map(async (r: any) => {
          const [collectionRate, balance, openIncidents] = await Promise.all([
            Residence.getCollectionRate(r._id, period),
            Residence.getBalance(r._id),
            Incident.countDocuments({
              residence: r._id,
              status: { $ne: IncidentStatus.RESOLVED },
            }),
          ]);
          return {
            ...r,
            stats: { period, collectionRate, ...balance, openIncidents },
          };
        })
      );
      return json(withStats);
    }
    return undefined;
  },
});
````

### `lib/crud/residents.ts`

````typescript
import { createCrudRoutes } from "@/lib/crud/createCrudRoutes";
import { Resident } from "@/models/Resident";
import { Apartment } from "@/models/Apartment";
import { User } from "@/models/User";
import { getResidentApartmentIds, getSyndicResidenceIds } from "@/lib/auth-guard";
import { residentCreateSchema, residentUpdateSchema } from "@/lib/validations/resident";
import { Role } from "@/types/enums";
import { HttpError } from "@/lib/api";

async function getSyndicApartmentIds(userId: string): Promise<string[]> {
  const residenceIds = await getSyndicResidenceIds(userId);
  const apartmentIds = await Apartment.find({ residence: { $in: residenceIds } }).distinct("_id");
  return apartmentIds.map(String);
}

async function validateResidentAccount(userId?: string): Promise<void> {
  if (!userId) return;

  const account = await User.findOne({
    _id: userId,
    role: Role.RESIDENT,
    isActive: { $ne: false },
  })
    .select("_id")
    .lean();

  if (!account) {
    throw new HttpError(400, "Le compte associé doit être un compte résident actif");
  }
}

export const residentCrudRoutes = createCrudRoutes({
  model: Resident,
  createSchema: residentCreateSchema,
  updateSchema: residentUpdateSchema,
  access: {
    read: [Role.ADMIN, Role.SYNDIC, Role.RESIDENT],
    create: [Role.ADMIN, Role.SYNDIC],
    update: [Role.ADMIN, Role.SYNDIC],
    delete: [Role.ADMIN, Role.SYNDIC],
  },
  searchFields: ["fullName", "email", "phone"],
  defaultSort: { fullName: 1 },
  populate: [
    {
      path: "apartment",
      select: "number floor residence",
      populate: { path: "residence", select: "name" },
    },
    { path: "user", select: "name email" },
  ],
  filterFields: ["apartment", "type", "isActive"],
  dateField: "moveInDate",
  exportPopulate: [{ path: "apartment", select: "number" }],
  exportColumns: [
    { key: "fullName", label: "Nom" },
    { key: "phone", label: "Téléphone" },
    { key: "email", label: "Email" },
    { key: "type", label: "Type" },
    { key: "apartment.number", label: "Appartement" },
    { key: "moveInDate", label: "Emménagement" },
    { key: "isActive", label: "Actif" },
  ],

  scope: async (user) => {
    // 1. ADMIN : accès global
    if (user.role === Role.ADMIN) {
      return {};
    }
    // 2. SYNDIC : résidents des appartements gérés
    if (user.role === Role.SYNDIC) {
      const aptIds = await getSyndicApartmentIds(user.id);
      return { apartment: { $in: aptIds } };
    }
    // 3. RESIDENT : résidents de son propre appartement
    if (user.role === Role.RESIDENT) {
      const allowedAptIds = await getResidentApartmentIds(user.id);
      return { apartment: { $in: allowedAptIds } };
    }
    return {};
  },

  beforeCreate: async (user, body) => {
    const apt = await Apartment.findById(body.apartment).lean();
    if (!apt) {
      throw new HttpError(404, "Appartement introuvable");
    }

    if (user.role === Role.SYNDIC) {
      const syndicResidences = await getSyndicResidenceIds(user.id);
      if (!syndicResidences.includes(String(apt.residence))) {
        throw new HttpError(403, "Vous n'administrez pas la résidence de cet appartement");
      }
    }

    await validateResidentAccount(body.user);
  },

  beforeUpdate: async (id, user, body) => {
    const managedApartmentIds =
      user.role === Role.SYNDIC ? await getSyndicApartmentIds(user.id) : null;
    const currentFilter =
      managedApartmentIds === null
        ? { _id: id }
        : { _id: id, apartment: { $in: managedApartmentIds } };
    const currentResident = await Resident.findOne(currentFilter).select("apartment").lean();

    if (!currentResident) {
      throw new HttpError(404, "Ressource introuvable ou modification non autorisée");
    }

    const requestedApartmentId = body.apartment;
    if (requestedApartmentId !== undefined && typeof requestedApartmentId !== "string") {
      throw new HttpError(400, "Identifiant d'appartement invalide");
    }
    const apartmentId = requestedApartmentId ?? String(currentResident.apartment);
    if (managedApartmentIds && !managedApartmentIds.includes(apartmentId)) {
      throw new HttpError(403, "Vous n'administrez pas la résidence de cet appartement");
    }

    const apartment = await Apartment.findById(apartmentId).select("_id").lean();
    if (!apartment) {
      throw new HttpError(404, "Appartement introuvable");
    }

    const requestedUserId = body.user;
    if (requestedUserId !== undefined && typeof requestedUserId !== "string") {
      throw new HttpError(400, "Identifiant de compte invalide");
    }
    await validateResidentAccount(requestedUserId);
  },
});
````

````typescript
import { createCrudRoutes } from "@/lib/crud/createCrudRoutes";
import { Resolution } from "@/models/Resolution";
import { Meeting } from "@/models/Meeting";
import { Vote } from "@/models/Vote";
import { getResidentResidenceIds, getSyndicResidenceIds } from "@/lib/auth-guard";
import { resolutionCreateSchema, resolutionUpdateSchema } from "@/lib/validations/governance";
import { Role } from "@/types/enums";
import { HttpError } from "@/lib/api";

export const resolutionCrudRoutes = createCrudRoutes({
  model: Resolution,
  createSchema: resolutionCreateSchema,
  updateSchema: resolutionUpdateSchema,
  access: {
    read: [Role.ADMIN, Role.SYNDIC, Role.RESIDENT],
    create: [Role.ADMIN, Role.SYNDIC],
    update: [Role.ADMIN, Role.SYNDIC],
    delete: [Role.ADMIN, Role.SYNDIC],
  },
  searchFields: ["title", "description"],
  defaultSort: { createdAt: -1 },
  populate: [{ path: "meeting", select: "title date status residence" }],
  filterFields: ["meeting"],

  scope: async (user) => {
    if (user.role === Role.ADMIN) return {};
    if (user.role === Role.SYNDIC) {
      const resIds = await getSyndicResidenceIds(user.id);
      const meetingIds = await Meeting.find({ residence: { $in: resIds } }).distinct("_id");
      return { meeting: { $in: meetingIds } };
    }
    if (user.role === Role.RESIDENT) {
      const resIds = await getResidentResidenceIds(user.id);
      const meetingIds = await Meeting.find({ residence: { $in: resIds } }).distinct("_id");
      return { meeting: { $in: meetingIds } };
    }
    return {};
  },

  beforeCreate: async (user, body) => {
    const meeting = await Meeting.findById(body.meeting);
    if (!meeting) {
      throw new HttpError(404, "Assemblée générale introuvable");
    }
    if (user.role === Role.SYNDIC) {
      const syndicRes = await getSyndicResidenceIds(user.id);
      if (!syndicRes.includes(meeting.residence.toString())) {
        throw new HttpError(403, "Vous n'administrez pas la résidence de cette assemblée");
      }
    }
  },

  beforeDelete: async (id) => {
    const voteCount = await Vote.countDocuments({ resolution: id });
    if (voteCount > 0) {
      throw new HttpError(
        409,
        `Impossible de supprimer une résolution qui a déjà fait l'objet de ${voteCount} vote(s).`
      );
    }
  },
});
````

### `lib/crud/votes.ts`

````typescript
import { createCrudRoutes } from "@/lib/crud/createCrudRoutes";
import { Vote } from "@/models/Vote";
import { Resolution } from "@/models/Resolution";
import { Meeting } from "@/models/Meeting";
import { Apartment } from "@/models/Apartment";
import {
  getResidentApartmentIds,
  getResidentResidenceIds,
  getSyndicResidenceIds,
} from "@/lib/auth-guard";
import { voteCreateSchema, voteUpdateSchema } from "@/lib/validations/governance";
import { MeetingStatus, Role } from "@/types/enums";
import { HttpError } from "@/lib/api";

export const voteCrudRoutes = createCrudRoutes({
  model: Vote,
  createSchema: voteCreateSchema,
  updateSchema: voteUpdateSchema,
  access: {
    read: [Role.ADMIN, Role.SYNDIC, Role.RESIDENT],
    create: [Role.ADMIN, Role.SYNDIC, Role.RESIDENT],
    update: [Role.ADMIN],
    delete: [Role.ADMIN],
  },
  searchFields: ["choice"],
  defaultSort: { votedAt: -1 },
  populate: [
    { path: "resolution", select: "title meeting requiredMajority" },
    { path: "apartment", select: "number shares floor" },
    { path: "voter", select: "name email" },
  ],
  filterFields: ["resolution", "apartment", "choice"],

  scope: async (user) => {
    if (user.role === Role.ADMIN) return {};
    if (user.role === Role.SYNDIC) {
      const resIds = await getSyndicResidenceIds(user.id);
      const meetingIds = await Meeting.find({ residence: { $in: resIds } }).distinct("_id");
      const resols = await Resolution.find({ meeting: { $in: meetingIds } }).distinct("_id");
      return { resolution: { $in: resols } };
    }
    if (user.role === Role.RESIDENT) {
      const myApts = await getResidentApartmentIds(user.id);
      return { apartment: { $in: myApts } };
    }
    return {};
  },

  beforeCreate: async (user, body) => {
    const resolution = await Resolution.findById(body.resolution);
    if (!resolution) {
      throw new HttpError(404, "Résolution introuvable");
    }

    const meeting = await Meeting.findById(resolution.meeting);
    if (!meeting) {
      throw new HttpError(404, "Assemblée générale introuvable");
    }

    // Règle métier : vote refusé si Meeting.status !== OPEN
    if (meeting.status !== MeetingStatus.OPEN) {
      throw new HttpError(
        400,
        `Le vote est refusé : l'assemblée générale n'est pas ouverte au vote (statut actuel : ${meeting.status}).`
      );
    }

    // Règle métier : appartement valide
    const apartment = await Apartment.findById(body.apartment);
    if (!apartment) {
      throw new HttpError(404, "Appartement introuvable");
    }

    // L'appartement doit appartenir à la même résidence que l'AG
    if (apartment.residence.toString() !== meeting.residence.toString()) {
      throw new HttpError(400, "Le lot n'appartient pas à la résidence de cette assemblée");
    }

    // Contrôle d'accès RESIDENT : ne peut voter qu'avec ses lots
    if (user.role === Role.RESIDENT) {
      const myApts = await getResidentApartmentIds(user.id);
      if (!myApts.includes(String(body.apartment))) {
        throw new HttpError(
          403,
          "Vous ne pouvez voter qu'au titre des lots dont vous êtes propriétaire ou résident"
        );
      }
    }

    // Règle métier : un seul vote par {resolution, apartment} (409 sinon)
    const existing = await Vote.findOne({
      resolution: body.resolution,
      apartment: body.apartment,
    });
    if (existing) {
      throw new HttpError(
        409,
        `Un vote a déjà été exprimé pour le lot ${apartment.number} sur cette résolution`
      );
    }
  },

  injectOnCreate: async (user, body) => {
    const apartment = await Apartment.findById(body.apartment);
    // Règle métier : weight = tantièmes du lot, voter = session.user.id
    return {
      voter: user.id,
      weight: apartment?.shares ?? 0,
      votedAt: new Date(),
    };
  },
});
````

### `lib/db.ts`

````typescript
import mongoose from "mongoose";

const MONGODB_URI = process.env.MONGODB_URI;

if (!MONGODB_URI) {
  throw new Error("MONGODB_URI manquant dans .env.local");
}

type MongooseCache = {
  conn: typeof mongoose | null;
  promise: Promise<typeof mongoose> | null;
};

const globalWithMongoose = global as typeof globalThis & {
  mongooseCache?: MongooseCache;
};

const cached: MongooseCache = (globalWithMongoose.mongooseCache ??= {
  conn: null,
  promise: null,
});

export async function connectDB() {
  if (cached.conn) return cached.conn;

  cached.promise ??= mongoose.connect(MONGODB_URI!, {
    bufferCommands: false,
  });

  cached.conn = await cached.promise;
  return cached.conn;
}
````

### `lib/incidents/access.ts`

````typescript
import { getSyndicResidenceIds, type AuthUser } from "@/lib/auth-guard";
import { HttpError } from "@/lib/api";
import { Incident } from "@/models/Incident";
import { Role } from "@/types/enums";

export async function requireIncidentAccess(user: AuthUser, incidentId: string) {
  const incident = await Incident.findById(incidentId);

  if (!incident) {
    throw new HttpError(404, "Incident introuvable");
  }

  if (user.role === Role.ADMIN) {
    return incident;
  }

  if (user.role === Role.SYNDIC) {
    const ids = await getSyndicResidenceIds(user.id);
    if (!ids.includes(incident.residence.toString())) {
      throw new HttpError(403, "Accès interdit");
    }
    return incident;
  }

  if (user.role === Role.RESIDENT) {
    if (incident.reportedBy?.toString() !== user.id) {
      throw new HttpError(403, "Accès interdit");
    }
    return incident;
  }

  if (user.role === Role.TECHNICIAN) {
    if (incident.assignedTo?.toString() !== user.id) {
      throw new HttpError(403, "Accès interdit");
    }
    return incident;
  }

  throw new HttpError(403, "Accès interdit");
}
````

### `lib/incidents/statistics.ts`

````typescript
import { Incident } from "@/models/Incident";
import { IncidentHistory } from "@/models/IncidentHistory";
import type { PipelineStage } from "mongoose";

type IncidentFilter = Record<string, unknown>;

export const DEFAULT_INCIDENT_OVERDUE_HOURS = 72;

export interface IncidentStatistics {
  total: number;
  reported: number;
  assigned: number;
  inProgress: number;
  resolved: number;
  urgent: number;
  high: number;
  overdue: number;
  averageResolutionHours: number;
  resolutionRate: number;
}

function normalizedFilter(filter: IncidentFilter) {
  return filter as Record<string, never>;
}

export async function getIncidentStatistics(
  filter: IncidentFilter,
  overdueHours = DEFAULT_INCIDENT_OVERDUE_HOURS
): Promise<IncidentStatistics> {
  const cutoff = new Date(Date.now() - overdueHours * 60 * 60 * 1000);
  const [result] = await Incident.aggregate([
    { $match: normalizedFilter(filter) },
    {
      $addFields: {
        resolutionDuration: {
          $cond: [
            {
              $and: [
                { $eq: ["$status", "RESOLVED"] },
                { $ne: [{ $ifNull: ["$resolvedAt", null] }, null] },
              ],
            },
            {
              $divide: [
                {
                  $subtract: [
                    "$resolvedAt",
                    { $ifNull: ["$createdAt", "$reportedAt"] },
                  ],
                },
                3_600_000,
              ],
            },
            null,
          ],
        },
        incidentCreatedAt: { $ifNull: ["$createdAt", "$reportedAt"] },
      },
    },
    {
      $group: {
        _id: null,
        total: { $sum: 1 },
        reported: { $sum: { $cond: [{ $eq: ["$status", "REPORTED"] }, 1, 0] } },
        assigned: { $sum: { $cond: [{ $eq: ["$status", "ASSIGNED"] }, 1, 0] } },
        inProgress: { $sum: { $cond: [{ $eq: ["$status", "IN_PROGRESS"] }, 1, 0] } },
        resolved: { $sum: { $cond: [{ $eq: ["$status", "RESOLVED"] }, 1, 0] } },
        urgent: { $sum: { $cond: [{ $eq: ["$priority", "URGENT"] }, 1, 0] } },
        high: { $sum: { $cond: [{ $eq: ["$priority", "HIGH"] }, 1, 0] } },
        overdue: {
          $sum: {
            $cond: [
              {
                $and: [
                  { $ne: ["$status", "RESOLVED"] },
                  { $lt: ["$incidentCreatedAt", cutoff] },
                ],
              },
              1,
              0,
            ],
          },
        },
        averageResolutionHours: { $avg: "$resolutionDuration" },
      },
    },
  ]);
  const stats = result ?? {};
  const total = Number(stats.total) || 0;
  const resolved = Number(stats.resolved) || 0;

  return {
    total,
    reported: Number(stats.reported) || 0,
    assigned: Number(stats.assigned) || 0,
    inProgress: Number(stats.inProgress) || 0,
    resolved,
    urgent: Number(stats.urgent) || 0,
    high: Number(stats.high) || 0,
    overdue: Number(stats.overdue) || 0,
    averageResolutionHours: Math.round(Number(stats.averageResolutionHours) || 0),
    resolutionRate: total ? Math.round((resolved / total) * 100) : 0,
  };
}

export async function getIncidentsByStatus(filter: IncidentFilter) {
  return Incident.aggregate([
    { $match: normalizedFilter(filter) },
    { $group: { _id: "$status", count: { $sum: 1 } } },
    { $sort: { _id: 1 } },
    { $project: { _id: 0, status: "$_id", count: 1 } },
  ]);
}

export async function getIncidentsByCategory(filter: IncidentFilter) {
  return Incident.aggregate([
    { $match: normalizedFilter(filter) },
    { $group: { _id: "$category", count: { $sum: 1 } } },
    { $sort: { _id: 1 } },
    { $project: { _id: 0, category: "$_id", count: 1 } },
  ]);
}

export interface MonthlyIncidentTrend {
  month: string;
  reported: number;
  resolved: number;
}

export async function getMonthlyIncidentTrends(
  filter: IncidentFilter,
  from: Date,
  to: Date
): Promise<MonthlyIncidentTrend[]> {
  const scopeFilter = { ...filter };
  delete scopeFilter.createdAt;
  const grouped = await Incident.aggregate([
    { $match: normalizedFilter(scopeFilter) },
    {
      $facet: {
        reported: [
          {
            $match: {
              $or: [
                { createdAt: { $gte: from, $lte: to } },
                {
                  createdAt: { $exists: false },
                  reportedAt: { $gte: from, $lte: to },
                },
              ],
            },
          },
          {
            $group: {
              _id: {
                $dateToString: {
                  format: "%Y-%m",
                  date: { $ifNull: ["$createdAt", "$reportedAt"] },
                },
              },
              count: { $sum: 1 },
            },
          },
          { $project: { _id: 0, month: "$_id", count: 1 } },
        ],
        resolved: [
          { $match: { status: "RESOLVED", resolvedAt: { $gte: from, $lte: to } } },
          {
            $group: {
              _id: { $dateToString: { format: "%Y-%m", date: "$resolvedAt" } },
              count: { $sum: 1 },
            },
          },
          { $project: { _id: 0, month: "$_id", count: 1 } },
        ],
      },
    },
  ]);
  const monthly = grouped[0] ?? { reported: [], resolved: [] };

  const months: MonthlyIncidentTrend[] = [];
  const cursor = new Date(Date.UTC(from.getUTCFullYear(), from.getUTCMonth(), 1));
  const last = new Date(Date.UTC(to.getUTCFullYear(), to.getUTCMonth(), 1));
  while (cursor <= last) {
    const month = `${cursor.getUTCFullYear()}-${String(cursor.getUTCMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0")}`;
    const reported = monthly.reported.find((item: { month: string }) => item.month === month);
    const resolved = monthly.resolved.find((item: { month: string }) => item.month === month);
    months.push({
      month,
      reported: Number(reported?.count) || 0,
      resolved: Number(resolved?.count) || 0,
    });
    cursor.setUTCMonth(cursor.getUTCMonth() + 1);
  }
  return months;
}

export async function getTechnicianPerformance(filter: IncidentFilter) {
  return Incident.aggregate([
    { $match: normalizedFilter(filter) },
    { $match: { assignedTo: { $ne: null } } },
    {
      $group: {
        _id: "$assignedTo",
        assigned: { $sum: 1 },
        completed: { $sum: { $cond: [{ $eq: ["$status", "RESOLVED"] }, 1, 0] } },
        inProgress: { $sum: { $cond: [{ $eq: ["$status", "IN_PROGRESS"] }, 1, 0] } },
        averageResolutionHours: {
          $avg: {
            $cond: [
              { $and: [{ $eq: ["$status", "RESOLVED"] }, { $ne: ["$resolvedAt", null] }] },
              {
                $divide: [
                  { $subtract: ["$resolvedAt", { $ifNull: ["$createdAt", "$reportedAt"] }] },
                  3_600_000,
                ],
              },
              null,
            ],
          },
        },
      },
    },
    { $lookup: { from: "users", localField: "_id", foreignField: "_id", pipeline: [{ $project: { name: 1, _id: 0 } }], as: "technician" } },
    { $unwind: { path: "$technician", preserveNullAndEmptyArrays: true } },
    {
      $project: {
        _id: 0,
        technicianId: { $toString: "$_id" },
        name: { $ifNull: ["$technician.name", "Technicien"] },
        assigned: 1,
        completed: 1,
        inProgress: 1,
        averageResolutionHours: { $round: [{ $ifNull: ["$averageResolutionHours", 0] }, 0] },
      },
    },
    { $sort: { assigned: -1, name: 1 } },
    { $limit: 50 },
  ]);
}

export async function getResidenceComparison(filter: IncidentFilter) {
  return Incident.aggregate([
    { $match: normalizedFilter(filter) },
    { $group: { _id: "$residence", incidents: { $sum: 1 } } },
    { $lookup: { from: "residences", localField: "_id", foreignField: "_id", pipeline: [{ $project: { name: 1, _id: 0 } }], as: "residence" } },
    { $unwind: { path: "$residence", preserveNullAndEmptyArrays: true } },
    {
      $project: {
        _id: 0,
        residenceId: { $toString: "$_id" },
        name: { $ifNull: ["$residence.name", "Résidence"] },
        incidents: 1,
      },
    },
    { $sort: { incidents: -1, name: 1 } },
    { $limit: 50 },
  ]);
}

export async function getRecentIncidentActivity(filter: IncidentFilter, limit = 10) {
  const pipeline: PipelineStage[] = [
    { $match: normalizedFilter(filter) },
    { $project: { _id: 1, title: 1, category: 1, priority: 1, status: 1, residence: 1 } },
    {
      $lookup: {
        from: IncidentHistory.collection.name,
        localField: "_id",
        foreignField: "incident",
        as: "history",
      },
    },
    { $unwind: "$history" },
    { $sort: { "history.createdAt": -1 } },
    {
      $project: {
        _id: { $toString: "$history._id" },
        incidentId: { $toString: "$_id" },
        title: 1,
        category: 1,
        priority: 1,
        status: 1,
        residenceId: { $toString: "$residence" },
        action: "$history.action",
        description: "$history.description",
        createdAt: "$history.createdAt",
      },
    },
    { $limit: Math.min(50, Math.max(1, limit)) },
  ];
  return Incident.aggregate(pipeline);
}
````

### `lib/incidents/workflow.ts`

````typescript
import { IncidentStatus } from "@/types/enums";

/**
 * Workflow strict des incidents (partagé client / serveur, sans dépendance serveur) :
 * REPORTED -> ASSIGNED -> IN_PROGRESS -> RESOLVED
 */
export const INCIDENT_TRANSITIONS: Record<IncidentStatus, IncidentStatus[]> = {
  [IncidentStatus.REPORTED]: [IncidentStatus.ASSIGNED],
  [IncidentStatus.ASSIGNED]: [IncidentStatus.IN_PROGRESS],
  [IncidentStatus.IN_PROGRESS]: [IncidentStatus.RESOLVED],
  [IncidentStatus.RESOLVED]: [],
};

/** Vrai si la transition from -> to est autorisée par le workflow. */
export function canTransition(from: IncidentStatus, to: IncidentStatus): boolean {
  return INCIDENT_TRANSITIONS[from]?.includes(to) ?? false;
}

/** Statut suivant dans le workflow (null si terminal). */
export function nextIncidentStatus(from: IncidentStatus): IncidentStatus | null {
  return INCIDENT_TRANSITIONS[from]?.[0] ?? null;
}
````
